stories.summary: A Nigerian court sentenced former power minister Saleh Mamman to 75 years in prison for laundering 33.8 billion naira (approximately $24.71 million). The conviction, announced by Nigeria's anti-graft agency, is a rare outcome for corruption cases in the country.

stories.title: Hungary summons Russian ambassador over drone strikes on western Ukraine
stories.summary: Hungary summoned Russia's ambassador over drone strikes on western Ukraine, Prime Minister Peter Magyar announced on Wednesday.

stories.title: Netanyahu's office says he visited UAE, Gulf state denies claim
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's office announced he secretly visited the UAE during Operation "Lion's Roar" and met with UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The UAE's Ministry of Foreign Affairs promptly denied the visit took place.

stories.title: ‘Basically a Chinese racket’: how China streaked ahead at a global AI conference
stories.summary: An analysis of papers accepted at the International Conference on Learning Representations found that Chinese universities accounted for about 44 percent of contributions from the top 50 institutions, significantly surpassing American rivals in AI research output.

stories.title: China parent brings son, 12, to work, where he plays with fire, destroying entire office
stories.summary: A 12-year-old boy in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, China, accidentally started a fire that destroyed an entire office after being brought to work by a parent on April 30. The child was left unsupervised and began playing with fire out of boredom.

stories.title: Moscow authorities restrict publication of photos and videos of aftermath of drone strikes
stories.summary: Moscow authorities imposed restrictions on publishing photos and videos showing the aftermath of drone strikes and other attacks described as "terrorist attacks," according to the office of Mayor Sergei Sobyanin.

stories.title: US’ Rubio calls on China to play an ‘active’ role in ending Iran war, despite Trump rhetoric
stories.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on China to play a more active role in resolving the Iran crisis ahead of the Trump-Xi summit in Beijing. Rubio described the Iran war as a major source of instability threatening Asia due to the region's reliance on the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Israeli attacks kill, wound nearly 60 children over the past week, despite truce deal
stories.summary: UNICEF reported that Israeli attacks across Lebanon killed and wounded at least 59 children over the past week despite a ceasefire that took effect on April 17. Over 23 children have been killed and 93 injured since the truce began.

stories.title: Saudi warplanes struck militias in Iraq during war, sources say
stories.summary: Saudi fighter jets struck targets linked to Iranian-backed Shiite militias in Iraq during the Iran war, according to multiple sources. Retaliatory strikes were also launched from Kuwait into Iraq.

stories.title: US Army recovers remains of second soldier reported missing during Moroccan exercise
stories.summary: The U.S. Army recovered the remains of Spc. Mariyah Symone Collington, 19, one of two soldiers reported missing on May 2 during a military exercise in Morocco. The recovery concluded a multinational search effort.

stories.title: Saudi warplanes struck Iran-backed militias in Iraq during war, sources say
stories.summary: Sources report that Saudi warplanes struck Iran-backed militias in Iraq during the Iran war, targeting sites near Saudi Arabia's northern border used to launch drones and missiles at Gulf states. Kuwait also reportedly fired on positions in Iraq.

stories.title: Russia damages 1,783 cultural heritage sites in Ukraine
stories.summary: As of early May 2026, Russia has destroyed or damaged 1,783 cultural heritage sites and 2,540 cultural infrastructure facilities in Ukraine since the start of its full-scale invasion. The figures underscore the extensive toll of the conflict on Ukraine's cultural patrimony.

stories.title: Soldier sentenced to 30 days in prison after IDF Chief of Staff catches him with 'Messiah' patch
stories.summary: An IDF soldier was sentenced to 30 days in prison after Chief of Staff Zamir discovered him wearing a 'Messiah' patch during a West Bank tour. Zamir encountered several soldiers behaving inappropriately and failing to follow military discipline.

stories.title: Netanyahu’s office says he visited UAE secretly during the Iran war
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's office confirmed he secretly visited the UAE during the war with Iran. The disclosure followed US Ambassador Mike Huckabee's revelation that Israel sent Iron Dome air-defence systems and personnel to the UAE.

stories.title: ​Elusive peace: On the Russia-Ukraine war
stories.summary: An editorial argues that Europe must actively push for a negotiated settlement to end the Russia-Ukraine war, emphasizing the difficulty of achieving lasting peace through military means alone.

stories.title: PTI defends MNA Iqbal Afridi’s son over asylum move, assails govt’s ‘oppression’
stories.summary: Pakistan's PTI party defended the son of MNA Iqbal Afridi after he surrendered his passport and sought asylum in a European country, saying government oppression left him no alternative. The issue surfaced during a National Assembly Standing Committee meeting where a state minister alleged the son used a diplomatic passport.

stories.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians and burn land in occupied West Bank
stories.summary: Armed Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian homes in the Masafer Yatta area of Hebron, injuring a Palestinian resident and a foreign activist. Settlers also set fire to agricultural land in the village of Al-Mughayyir near Ramallah.

stories.title: Japan-South Korea ‘comfort women’ row stoked by statues abroad
stories.summary: Disputes over "comfort women" statues erected abroad by South Korean civic groups have reignited tensions between Japan and South Korea. Local governments in Berlin and Auckland have moved to rescind or decline permits for the memorials, drawing support from Japanese conservatives.

stories.title: Trump-Xi summit live: US, China leaders to hold talks on trade, tech, Iran
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a summit in Beijing addressing trade tensions, technology disputes, and the ongoing war on Iran, which continues to disrupt global commerce.

stories.title: Iran war live: Tehran slams ‘collusion’ as Netanyahu ‘secretly’ visits UAE
stories.summary: Iran's first vice president asserted that Tehran's sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz is established and non-negotiable, condemning what it called collusion following reports of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's secret visit to the UAE.

stories.title: Major among five soldiers martyred during operation in Balochistan’s Barkhan: ISPR
stories.summary: Five Pakistani soldiers, including a major, were killed during a security operation in Barkhan district, Balochistan, targeting militants the state designates as Fitna al Hindustan. Seven militants were also killed in the joint Pakistan Army and Frontier Corps operation in the Nosham area.

stories.title: New York man found guilty of acting as an unregistered agent of China
stories.summary: A federal jury in Brooklyn found Lu Jianwang, 64, of New York, guilty of acting as an unregistered agent of the Chinese government. Prosecutors accused him of operating a covert police station in Manhattan's Chinatown on behalf of Beijing starting in 2022 and helping locate a pro-democracy activist.

stories.title: How has the Iran war affected Middle East states?
stories.summary: The war that began on February 28 with a large-scale Israeli-U.S. bombing campaign against Iran has destabilized the broader Middle East, damaging infrastructure and economies and upending long-standing regional security assumptions.

stories.title: Iran frees prominent rights lawyer Sotoudeh on bail, reports say
stories.summary: Iran released prominent human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh on bail on Wednesday. She had been arrested in early April during a crackdown amid the conflict with the United States and Israel.

stories.title: Zelensky thanks Hungarian PM Magyar for condemning Russian attack
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar for condemning Russia's latest attack on Ukraine. The exchange highlights diplomatic engagement between Kyiv and Budapest on the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Board of Peace envoy: Hamas tightening its grip on Gaza, taxing those with nothing left
stories.summary: Board of Peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov said Hamas is tightening its grip on Gaza and taxing impoverished residents. He stated that a disarmament plan would not eliminate Hamas as a political movement, with weapons to be handed to a technocratic government rather than Israel.

stories.title: 'Beginning of end of worst gov't in history': Opposition heads react to Knesset dissolution bill
stories.summary: Israeli opposition leaders reacted to a Knesset dissolution bill, with Benny Gantz calling it the beginning of the end of what he described as the worst government in Israeli history. The bill signals a potential move toward new elections in Israel.

stories.title: UAE denies Netanyahu held secret meeting with Emirati president during Iran war
stories.summary: The UAE's foreign ministry denied claims from Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's office that he secretly visited the UAE and met President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed during the war with Iran. The Emirati statement emphasized that its relations with Israel are conducted publicly and transparently.

stories.title: 'No indication' Andes strain of hantavirus has mutated: EU agency
stories.summary: The EU's European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control said there is no indication that the Andes strain of hantavirus has mutated following a deadly outbreak on a cruise ship traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde. Three passengers died and at least seven others were confirmed infected, with all evacuated and quarantined.

stories.title: UN rights chief calls on Israel to abolish Oct 7 military tribunal
stories.summary: The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights called on Israel to abolish a military tribunal established to handle cases related to the October 7 attacks. Israel's parliament had passed legislation creating the tribunal.

stories.title: Nearly 9,000 war crime cases launched in Dnipropetrovsk region – Prosecutor’s Office
stories.summary: Authorities in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region have opened 8,958 criminal proceedings related to alleged war crimes committed by Russian military forces. The Prosecutor's Office reported the cases as part of ongoing efforts to document and prosecute violations in the region.

stories.title: Chinese memory module makers ramp up production as CXMT DDR5 breakthrough hits market
stories.summary: Chinese memory module manufacturer Powev has begun mass production of 64GB DDR5-5600 RDIMM server memory under its Sinker brand, using chips from ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT). The development reflects CXMT's breakthrough in domestic DDR5 chip production, which is now filtering through China's memory supply chain to both consumer and enterprise markets.

stories.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
stories.summary: In southern Lebanon, many residents continue to support Hezbollah despite ongoing Israeli military operations and occupation, viewing the armed group as the only force capable of defending them even as a ceasefire remains ineffective.

stories.title: Sarah Lawrence student senate rejects J Street U chapter after fierce backlash
stories.summary: The student senate at Sarah Lawrence College rejected a petition to recognize a J Street U chapter on campus. Some student senators reportedly compared the group to a white supremacist organization during the debate.

stories.title: War update: 187 clashes on front line, Pokrovsk, Huliaipole sectors see fiercest fighting
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces recorded 187 combat engagements along the front line in the past day. The heaviest fighting was concentrated in the Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors, where Russian forces launched nearly 50 attacks.

stories.title: No Indo-Pacific peace without industry surge and burden sharing, US general says
stories.summary: U.S. Army Gen. Xavier Brunson stated that expanding industrial capacity to far-reaching frontlines and increasing burden sharing among allies are essential for Indo-Pacific security. He emphasized the need for an industry surge to support operations across the region.

stories.title: Russia places former UK defence minister Ben Wallace on wanted list
stories.summary: Russia placed former UK Defence Minister Ben Wallace on its wanted list. Wallace has been a vocal critic of Russian aggression in Ukraine.

stories.title: State Duma passes bill on president’s right to use armed forces to protect Russians abroad
stories.summary: Russia's State Duma passed a bill authorizing the president to deploy armed forces abroad to protect Russian citizens. The legislation cleared both its second and third readings.

stories.title: Iran working on Hormuz ‘protocol’ to cover ‘costs’, says Minister Gharibabadi
stories.summary: Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Iran is developing a protocol for the Strait of Hormuz to cover associated costs. He suggested a BRICS-member neighbouring country, reportedly the UAE, is attempting to undermine a joint statement by pushing for condemnation of Iran.

stories.title: Trump administration offers $100m in aid to Cuba in exchange for reform
stories.summary: The Trump administration offered Cuba $100 million in aid contingent on political reforms, while an oil blockade continues to affect the island. Washington blamed Cuba's communist leadership for obstructing the delivery of assistance.

stories.title: Remains of second US soldier who went missing during military exercises in Morocco have been recovered
stories.summary: The U.S. Army confirmed the recovery of remains of Spc. Mariyah Symone Collington, 19, of Tavares, Florida, who went missing during military exercises in Morocco. Collington and Spc. Kendrick Lamont Key Jr. died after falling off a cliff during an off-duty hike near Cap Draa. A multinational search operation using air, naval, and AI assets was deployed.

stories.title: Housing market in England and Wales weakening due to Iran war, say estate agents
stories.summary: Estate agents in England and Wales report weakening housing demand linked to fears of mortgage rate rises and higher inflation stemming from the Iran war. A Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors survey found a noticeable softening in buyer interest as sellers hold back properties.

stories.title: Hong Kong tech crimes are dropping. So why is hacking becoming more lucrative?
stories.summary: Hong Kong police reported that overall technology-related crimes declined over the past year, but financial losses from hacking more than doubled to HK$62.6 million (approximately US$8 million). Senior Superintendent Carmen Leung of the cybersecurity and technology crime bureau attributed the increased losses to several high-value cyberattacks targeting financial institutions.

stories.title: Warm words, thin relief: Macron's Africa financial push under scrutiny
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced $27 billion in new investments at a Franco-African summit in Nairobi, Kenya. The pledges face scrutiny over whether they will deliver meaningful economic relief to African nations.

stories.title: France probes whether Israeli firm BlackCore interfered in local elections, sources say
stories.summary: French authorities are investigating whether Israeli firm BlackCore carried out a foreign interference campaign targeting a hard-left party ahead of France's March municipal elections, according to three sources familiar with the matter.

stories.title: Zelensky proposes cooperation in Drone Deal format to Romania
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky proposed a cooperation framework with Romania under a special Drone Deal format aimed at bolstering drone-related collaboration between the two countries.

stories.title: Israel’s ruling coalition proposes early elections amid ultra-Orthodox anger at Netanyahu
stories.summary: Israel's ruling Likud party submitted a proposal to dissolve parliament and hold early elections amid mounting pressure from ultra-Orthodox coalition partners. The ultra-Orthodox parties are angry at Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over his failure to secure military service exemptions, putting the multi-party coalition at risk of collapse.

stories.title: Ukraine attacks Russian energy sites - what has been hit?
stories.summary: Ukraine has intensified attacks on Russian energy infrastructure in recent months as peace negotiations have stalled. Multiple energy sites across Russia have been targeted.

stories.title: Latvian government loses majority in parliament over handling of Ukraine drone incidents
stories.summary: Latvia's Prime Minister Evika Silina lost her ruling majority in parliament on Wednesday after the left-wing Progressives party withdrew support over the government's handling of Ukraine-related drone incidents on Latvian territory.

stories.title: Turkey’s Kurdish peace process falters as Iran war complicates negotiations - analysis
stories.summary: Turkey's peace process with Kurdish militants has stalled as the ongoing Iran war deepens regional instability. Both sides have reportedly been reluctant to take decisive steps toward a resolution.

stories.title: Coalition submits bill to dissolve Knesset, vote expected next week
stories.summary: Israel's governing coalition submitted a bill to dissolve the Knesset, with a vote expected next week. The move comes as opposition figures Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid launched a joint campaign under their merged Together party.

stories.title: Howard Lutnick said he had three ‘meaningless and inconsequential’ meetings with Epstein
stories.summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told a House committee in a closed-door interview that he had only three "meaningless and inconsequential" meetings with Jeffrey Epstein. Lutnick denied any personal or professional relationship with the disgraced financier, according to a newly released transcript.

stories.title: US wants China to press Iran to change course in Gulf: Secretary of State
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington hopes to convince China to take a more active role in pressuring Iran to change its behavior in the Gulf. Rubio made the comments in an interview aired on Fox News on Wednesday.

stories.title: Herzog warns Israel’s greatest internal threat is growing division at ‘Time to Talk’ conference
stories.summary: Former Israeli President Isaac Herzog spoke at a 'Time to Talk' conference, warning that growing internal division poses the greatest domestic threat to Israel.

stories.title: Lebanon says 10 more killed in Israeli strikes on south
stories.summary: Lebanon's health ministry reported that 10 more people were killed in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon on Wednesday, raising the day's death toll to at least 22. Victims included children and women in the towns of Arab Salim, Harouf, and Roumin.

stories.title: Netanyahu says he 'secretly visited' UAE during war with Iran
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office claimed he made a secret visit to the UAE during the war with Iran. The UAE denied the report, stating that relations between the two countries were not based on unofficial arrangements.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces wipe out Russian Merlin-VR reconnaissance drone
stories.summary: Operators of Ukraine's Phoenix Border Guard Unit destroyed a Russian Merlin-VR reconnaissance drone on the eastern front.

stories.title: Australia politics live: Taylor unveils policy to block noncitizens from access to 17 benefits including paid parental leave
stories.summary: Australian opposition leader Taylor announced a policy to block noncitizens from accessing 17 government benefits, including paid parental leave. Housing minister Clare O'Neil separately discussed budget measures aimed at helping first home buyers compete against investors at property auctions.

stories.title: Influencer detained in Tennessee over alleged confrontation involving gunfire
stories.summary: Dalton Eatherly, 28, an online influencer known as Chud the Builder, was detained in Clarksville, Tennessee, after an alleged shooting outside the Montgomery County courthouse. The district attorney's office said shots were fired during a confrontation with another man on Wednesday afternoon.

stories.title: US renews $100M aid offer to crisis-hit Cuba while tightening sanctions
stories.summary: The United States renewed a $100 million aid offer to Cuba as the island faces worsening blackouts and a deepening economic crisis. Washington is simultaneously tightening sanctions, increasing pressure on Havana over fuel shortages and political reform.

stories.title: Third round of Israel-Lebanon talks to take place with military officials, sources tell 'Post'
stories.summary: A third round of Israel-Lebanon negotiations is set to take place involving military officials from both sides. Lebanon's military attaché in Washington and IDF Head of Strategy Brig.-Gen. Amichai Levin will be among the delegations' representatives.

stories.title: Iranian FM threatens UAE, claims Tehran knew of Netanyahu’s visit to Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: Iran's foreign minister threatened the UAE and claimed Tehran had prior knowledge of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's reported visit to Abu Dhabi. The UAE has denied the visit took place, while Netanyahu's former spokesman maintained that the wartime trip occurred.

stories.title: The Shottas
stories.summary: The Shottas are a leading criminal group in Colombia's port city of Buenaventura, known for their violent rivalry with the Espartanos. In 2022, both groups agreed to participate in President Gustavo Petro's "Total Peace" plan, which aims to establish an urban peace laboratory in the city.

stories.title: Israeli firm BlackCore investigated for role in alleged French election smear campaign
stories.summary: French authorities are investigating Israeli firm BlackCore for allegedly conducting a smear campaign against left-wing candidates ahead of France's March municipal elections.

stories.title: Iran military says control over Hormuz to bring significant economic revenues
stories.summary: An Iranian military spokesperson stated that Iran's control over the Strait of Hormuz could generate significant economic revenues, potentially doubling the country's oil income.

stories.title: U.S. House gathers votes to force consideration of USD1.3B aid package for Ukraine – NYT
stories.summary: The US House of Representatives gathered enough signatures to force a vote on a $1.3 billion military aid package for Ukraine, according to The New York Times.

stories.title: 'Rogue state behaviour': Israel carrying out covert influence operations in Canada, report says
stories.summary: A report alleges that Israel has been conducting covert influence operations in Canada. The advocacy group Canadians for Justice and Peace in the Middle East is calling for Israeli agents to face scrutiny comparable to that applied to Chinese or Indian operatives.

stories.title: Chinese-American found guilty in New York ‘secret police station’ case
stories.summary: A federal jury in New York's Eastern District Court found Chinese-American Lu "Harry" Jianwang, 64, guilty on three charges of acting as a Chinese agent. The case centered on an undeclared Chinese police station established in New York's Chinatown, which prosecutors said was used to intimidate Chinese diaspora communities.

stories.title: ‘Transactional’ but pivotal: how Xi-Trump talks could redefine US-China fault lines
stories.summary: President Trump arrived in Beijing on Wednesday for the first US presidential visit to China in years, amid the US-Iran war's disruption of global energy supplies. The visit comes as Washington and Beijing navigate tensions compounded by geopolitical crises and economic interdependence.

stories.title: Iran war brings Turkey-PKK peace process to near standstill
stories.summary: Turkey's peace process with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) has nearly stalled after the Iran war erupted, introducing fresh instability to the Middle East. The setback came just two weeks after Turkey's parliament made recommendations on advancing the peace process.

stories.title: Explainer-What's at stake in Turkey's bid to end conflict with PKK militants?
stories.summary: Turkey's decades-old effort to resolve its conflict with the PKK militant group has stalled, with both sides waiting for the other to act. The ongoing Iran war has further complicated the peace bid.

stories.title: Russian airspace breaches show need to boost NATO eastern flank air defence, say leaders
stories.summary: Leaders of 14 NATO allied nations meeting in Bucharest called for strengthened air defences along the alliance's eastern flank. The statement followed repeated Russian airspace violations of NATO member countries, highlighting the need for improved missile and drone defense capabilities.

stories.title: Mass protests in Argentina decry Milei's funding cuts to prized public universities
stories.summary: Mass protests erupted across Argentina against President Javier Milei's funding cuts to public universities. Milei, echoing ally U.S. President Donald Trump, has characterized university campuses as centers of ideological indoctrination.

stories.title: Price shocks from the Iran war power solar sales in energy-hungry Asia
stories.summary: Rising fuel costs driven by the Iran war are accelerating adoption of rooftop solar power across energy-dependent Asian nations. China, as the world's largest provider of solar technology, stands to benefit significantly from the shift in demand.

stories.title: Injury toll rises to eight following Russian drone attack on Ivano-Frankivsk
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck a residential high-rise building in Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine, injuring at least eight people, including a minor.

stories.title: Palestinians say West Bank teen killed by Israeli fire
stories.summary: Palestinian sources reported that a teenager was killed by Israeli fire in the occupied West Bank. Four other people were injured in the incident.

stories.title: Both Trump and Xi Overestimate Themselves
stories.summary: The article examines the US-China summit, arguing that elites in both countries are prone to overestimating their own strengths. The analysis suggests both President Trump and President Xi bring inflated self-assessments to their diplomatic engagement.

stories.title: Israeli drone strikes on vehicles in Lebanon kill 12, including 2 children
stories.summary: Israeli drone strikes on vehicles in Lebanon killed 12 people, including two children. Lebanon and Israel are scheduled to hold another round of direct talks in Washington on Thursday.

stories.title: IDF officers said to tell PM Jewish terror accounts for up to 80% of West Bank incidents
stories.summary: IDF officers reportedly informed the Israeli prime minister that Jewish settler violence accounts for up to 80% of security incidents in the West Bank. Officers warned the issue is diverting resources from offensive operations. A Palestinian teenager was reportedly killed by the IDF following a settler raid.

stories.title: Cartel corruption claims push US-Mexico relations to breaking point
stories.summary: US-Mexico relations are under severe strain amid Washington's accusations that Mexican officials have colluded with drug trafficking organizations. President Claudia Sheinbaum pushed back against the allegations, while analysts compared the tensions to the most fraught period since the 1980s. Reports of CIA agents operating in Mexico have added further friction.

stories.title: Why stability must come before denuclearisation on the Korean peninsula
stories.summary: Following US strikes on Iran, North Korea has doubled down on deterrence rather than showing interest in denuclearization. Pyongyang has tightened security around its leadership and continued missile launches, signaling sensitivity to Washington's military posture in the region.

stories.title: UN food agency halves Syria food aid, halts bread subsidy over funding shortages
stories.summary: The World Food Programme announced it has halved emergency food assistance in Syria due to funding shortages and halted bread subsidies. The agency warned that millions of Syrians remain vulnerable despite some signs of stabilisation in parts of the country.

stories.title: Two drone strikes hit Iranian opposition camp north of Iraq’s Erbil, security sources say
stories.summary: Two drone strikes targeted an Iranian opposition camp north of Erbil in Iraq's Kurdistan region, according to security sources. The strikes reportedly hit an arms and ammunition depot inside the camp.

stories.title: Trade, tech, and rare earths to dominate Trump's China trip
stories.summary: President Trump's visit to China is expected to focus on trade, technology, and rare earth minerals, with more than a dozen executives from major companies joining the delegation. Separately, the US Senate approved Kevin Warsh as the next Chairman of the Federal Reserve.

stories.title: Ukrinform journalist Olha Zvonariova wins prestigious military journalism award in Italy
stories.summary: Ukrinform journalist Olha Zvonariova received the Premio Montecatini di Giornalismo 2026 award in Italy, recognizing outstanding editorial work on defense, security, and armed forces coverage.

stories.title: Pakistan, WHO launch Prime Minister's Hepatitis C Elimination Programme
stories.summary: Pakistan's Ministry of Health and the World Health Organisation launched the Prime Minister's Hepatitis C Elimination Programme in Islamabad, aiming to reach 1.6 million people within six months and eliminate the disease as a public health threat by 2030.

stories.title: Funeral held for two Lebanese paramedics killed in Israeli attack
stories.summary: Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of two Lebanese paramedics who were killed in an Israeli strike. The ceremony drew significant public attendance as communities mourned the loss of emergency responders.

stories.title: World Food Programme slashes Syria aid, affecting 7.2 million as funding crisis deepens
stories.summary: The World Food Programme has cut emergency food aid in Syria by half due to funding shortages, affecting approximately 7.2 million people despite signs of stabilization in the country.

stories.title: US Senate warns of China’s nuclear capabilities hours before Xi-Trump summit
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate Armed Services Committee held a hearing on nuclear capabilities, with Chairman Roger Wicker warning of China's "unprecedented nuclear expansion," including construction of hundreds of new missile silos. The hearing took place hours before President Trump's summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: As Trump readies to meet Xi, experts say he is ‘desperate for a win’
stories.summary: As President Trump prepares to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping, analysts suggest he is eager to secure a diplomatic achievement. Bilateral trade has declined since Trump took office, even as China's overall exports have reached record levels.

stories.title: Watch: Gold and silver import duties doubled following Modi’s appeal | Above the Fold | 13.05.2026
stories.summary: India's central government doubled import duties on gold and silver as part of austerity measures amid a deepening West Asia crisis. The episode also covers U.S. President Donald Trump's visit to China and BJP leaders reducing convoy sizes.

stories.title: S. African non-Jewish activists protest at Holocaust center with ‘Jews for Free Palestine' shirts
stories.summary: Non-Jewish South African activists staged a protest at a Holocaust center wearing "Jews for Free Palestine" shirts, claiming solidarity with Jewish voices who reject Zionism and call for Palestinian freedom.

stories.title: Philip Davis and Progressive Liberal Party win general election in Bahamas
stories.summary: Philip Davis and his Progressive Liberal Party won the general election in the Bahamas. The victory marks the first time in three decades that a Bahamian political party has secured back-to-back election wins.

stories.title: Chinese-linked ships cross Strait of Hormuz on eve of Trump-Xi meeting
stories.summary: A Chinese-linked supertanker carrying two million barrels of Iraqi crude oil crossed the Strait of Hormuz and then turned off its transponder. The transit occurred on the eve of a meeting between U.S. President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: ‘The threat is manageable’: IDF downplays Hezbollah drone campaign
stories.summary: The deputy commander of the IDF's Sabar Battalion downplayed Hezbollah's drone campaign, saying the threat is manageable and has been exaggerated by observers outside the conflict zone.

stories.title: Senate confirms Trump pick Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate confirmed Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair in a highly partisan vote. Warsh takes over from Jerome Powell as policymakers warn that persistent inflation could complicate President Trump's push for lower borrowing costs.

stories.title: Republican redistricting effort is ‘evil incarnate’, Stacey Abrams tells new Guardian podcast
stories.summary: Former Georgia gubernatorial candidate Stacey Abrams criticized Republican-led redistricting efforts as "evil incarnate" in an interview with the Guardian's Stateside podcast. She argued that the gerrymandering amounts to intentional suppression of racial minority voting power.

stories.title: Hungary condemns drone attack on Zakarpattia, summons Russian ambassador
stories.summary: Hungary's new government condemned a Russian drone attack on Ukraine's western Zakarpattia region on Wednesday and summoned the Russian ambassador in Budapest in response.

stories.title: Paris Saint-Germain clinches a record-extending 14th French league title
stories.summary: Paris Saint-Germain clinched a record-extending 14th French league title with a 2-0 away win over Lens. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Ibrahim Mbaye scored the goals as PSG secured their fifth consecutive Ligue 1 crown and continued pursuing a potential historic treble.

stories.title: Israeli woman killed, several Israelis injured in Panama highway crash
stories.summary: An Israeli woman was killed and several other Israeli tourists were injured in a highway crash near La Chorrera, Panama. ZAKA is coordinating efforts to return the body and the wounded to Israel.

stories.title: France locks down 1,700 on cruise ship after 92-year-old dies
stories.summary: French authorities locked down approximately 1,700 people aboard a cruise ship after a 92-year-old passenger died. Officials said there was no established link to the hantavirus scare that affected the Dutch vessel MV Hondius.

stories.title: Trump shares fake quotes, falsely accuses Obama of treason in late-night rant
stories.summary: President Trump posted 55 times on social media in three hours before his China visit, sharing debunked conspiracy theories, AI-generated images, and false accusations of treason against former President Obama. He also revived claims that the 2020 election was stolen.

stories.title: White House denies reports of visa issues for Iraq’s World Cup team
stories.summary: The White House denied reports that Iraq's national football team players were refused US visas, confirming that all players have been cleared to travel for the World Cup.

stories.title: Crowds gather in Tehran to send off Iran’s World Cup team
stories.summary: Large crowds gathered in Tehran's Revolution Square to celebrate and send off Iran's national football team ahead of the World Cup.

stories.title: Ukraine, Lithuania sign drone deal to strengthen defense cooperation
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Lithuanian President Gitanas Nauseda signed a defense cooperation agreement under the Drone Deal format, focused on defense expertise and industry collaboration.

stories.title: 'Door to Gaza's future is still closed despite ceasefire,' BoP chief said after meeting Netanyahu
stories.summary: Board of Peace chief Nickolay Mladenov said after meeting Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu that the door to Gaza's future remains closed despite the ceasefire, criticizing the situation as falling short of promises made to Palestinians and Israeli security needs.

stories.title: Reform UK talking to watchdog over $7 million gift to leader Farage
stories.summary: Britain's Reform UK confirmed it is in discussions with the Parliamentary Commissioner for Standards after reports that leader Nigel Farage failed to declare a £5 million personal gift. The party denied any rules were broken.

stories.title: Senate fails to curb Trump’s war on Iran even as Republican opposition grows
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate rejected a war powers resolution by Senator Jeff Merkley aimed at ending American involvement in the war on Iran, failing 49-50. Three Republican senators — Lisa Murkowski, Rand Paul, and Susan Collins — voted in favor, while Democrat John Fetterman opposed it.

stories.title: Trump Has One Major Focus While in China: Trade
stories.summary: President Trump's visit to China is expected to prioritize trade negotiations above other bilateral issues. The US president is anticipated to downplay concerns such as security and human rights in pursuit of new trade deals.

stories.title: US ‘making progress’ in Iran talks, US vice president says
stories.summary: U.S. Vice President JD Vance stated that progress is being made in negotiations with Iran, though President Trump had rejected Tehran's latest proposal as unacceptable. Vance said the key threshold remains Trump's red line of ensuring Iran can never acquire a nuclear weapon.

stories.title: Five things you may not know about US-China ties
stories.summary: Al Jazeera presented a report highlighting five lesser-known aspects of the relationship between the United States and China.

stories.title: Russian commander ordered beheading of two fallen Ukrainian soldiers in Huliaipole sector – General Staff
stories.summary: Ukraine's General Staff reported that a Russian commander ordered the beheading of two fallen Ukrainian soldiers in the Huliaipole sector. Members of Ukraine's 225th Assault Regiment were ambushed by Russian forces that had infiltrated the front-line area.

stories.title: US Navy could run out of money by July, top officer warns
stories.summary: U.S. Chief of Naval Operations Admiral Daryl Caudle warned lawmakers that the Navy could run out of funding by July, potentially forcing modifications to training and operations.

stories.title: Russia wants joint economic projects with US — but only if Washington stops linking them to peace in Ukraine
stories.summary: Russia has expressed interest in pursuing joint economic projects with the United States but insists that Washington stop linking such cooperation to peace efforts in Ukraine.

stories.title: India Still Stands By BRICS
stories.summary: India reaffirmed its commitment to the BRICS group as foreign ministers from member nations convened in New Delhi. The meeting took place amid heightened global tensions and shifting geopolitical dynamics.

stories.title: Africa must drop 'victim mentality': mogul Tony Elumelu
stories.summary: Nigerian billionaire investor Tony Elumelu urged African nations to abandon a "victim mentality" and prioritize economic development and infrastructure rather than dwelling on colonial-era mistrust of foreign powers.

stories.title: Who gets to belong? Palestinians in Syria confront old suspicions under new rule
stories.summary: Palestinians in Syria face growing anxiety about their legal status under the country's new leadership, with arrests, media attacks, and changes in official terminology deepening suspicions toward the refugee community.

stories.title: New York Times report finds Eurovision to be 'soft power' tool for Israel
stories.summary: A New York Times investigation found that Israel has used the Eurovision Song Contest as a soft power tool, with influence efforts beginning years earlier than previously known. Data showed that in some countries, just a few hundred voters could have secured a popular vote victory.

stories.title: House Foreign Affairs greenlights trio of arms sale bills, including Taiwan support
stories.summary: The House Foreign Affairs Committee advanced three arms sale bills, including one supporting Taiwan. However, the committee rejected a separate bill that would have permitted any country to use Foreign Military Financing to buy weapons through the commercial sales process.

stories.title: In Iran’s holy city of Qom, Indian volunteers serve sharbat amid war fears and protests
stories.summary: Indian volunteers in Iran's holy city of Qom are serving sharbat to locals amid war fears and protests. The gesture is seen as a symbol of ordinary people choosing compassion despite shifting government positions and diplomatic uncertainty.

stories.title: Contractor awarded $3.5 billion to build out US Coast Guard’s Arctic Security Cutters fleet
stories.summary: Davie Defense was awarded a $3.5 billion contract to build a new class of Arctic Security Cutters for the U.S. Coast Guard. The contract covers five icebreaking vessels.

stories.title: Ukraine, Finland working on drone deal – Zelensky
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with Finnish President Alexander Stubb to discuss a bilateral drone deal and diplomatic efforts to end Russia's war against Ukraine.

stories.title: Israel's Netanyahu visited UAE during war on Iran
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office disclosed a visit to the UAE on March 26 during the war with Iran, after the US confirmed Israel had sent Iron Dome air-defence batteries to the Gulf state.

stories.title: US renews US$100 million Cuba aid offer as Trump raises island with Xi
stories.summary: The Trump administration publicly renewed an offer of $100 million in humanitarian aid to Cuba, timed as President Trump raised the issue of Cuba during his visit with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing.

stories.title: Ghana to bring home 300 after anti-migrant incidents in S.Africa
stories.summary: Ghana announced plans to evacuate approximately 300 Ghanaian nationals caught up in xenophobic attacks in South Africa.

stories.title: Twelve killed in strikes on cars as Israel pounds Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli strikes across Lebanon on Wednesday killed at least 12 people in attacks targeting cars, mostly south of Beirut, despite an existing ceasefire with Hezbollah. The strikes hit over 30 locations in the south and east, coming one day before US-brokered negotiations between Lebanon and Israel in Washington.

stories.title: Netanyahu met with UAE president at start of Operation Roaring Lion, PMO announces
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with the president of the United Arab Emirates at the outset of Operation Roaring Lion, according to the Prime Minister's Office. It was their first publicly disclosed meeting since the Abraham Accords were signed in 2020.

stories.title: Ukraine says it struck Russian oil, gas infrastructure
stories.summary: Ukraine's military said it struck a Russian oil terminal, a refinery, and a gas processing plant on Wednesday. The attacks on Russian energy infrastructure mark a renewal of such strikes following a short-lived ceasefire.

stories.title: Moscow orders media blackout on drone-strike and terrorist-attack aftermath photos
stories.summary: Moscow's city government issued an order banning the publication of photos and videos showing the aftermath of terrorist attacks and drone strikes within the city.

stories.title: Government offers summer extension of school programs following wartime disruptions
stories.summary: Israel's government announced an optional ten-day summer extension of school camp activities for kindergarten through grade six, along with a catch-up program for middle-school students. The measures aim to address educational disruptions caused by wartime conditions.

stories.title: Family of British couple jailed in Iran say they have lost contact
stories.summary: The family of British couple Lindsay and Craig Foreman, both 53, say they have lost all contact with them after they were sentenced to 10 years in Iranian prison on spying charges. The couple was arrested in January 2025 while motorcycling through Iran.

stories.title: Kremlin terms unchanged: Moscow repeats Putin’s 2024 demand for four Ukraine’s oblasts as peace push stalls
stories.summary: The Kremlin reiterated President Putin's 2024 demand that Ukraine cede four oblasts as a condition for peace talks. The demand has contributed to a stall in international peace efforts.

stories.title: Ukraine's air defense neutralizes 710 of 753 Russian drones in massive day-long attack
stories.summary: Ukraine's air defense forces intercepted 710 out of 753 Russian drones during a massive attack lasting from 08:00 to 18:30 on Wednesday. Hits and falling debris were recorded at 26 locations across the country.

stories.title: Warsh to succeed Powell at the Fed with inflation at three-year high
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate confirmed Kevin Warsh as the 17th Federal Reserve chair in a 54-45 vote, the most partisan confirmation vote for the role in history. Warsh, a former Fed governor and Morgan Stanley banker, takes office amid inflation at a three-year high.

stories.title: Putin Replaces Governors of War-Ravaged Belgorod and Bryansk Regions
stories.summary: Russian President Putin replaced the governors of the Belgorod and Bryansk border regions, both heavily affected by the war in Ukraine. He appointed a military general and a former senior official from occupied Ukraine to lead the two regions.

stories.title: Putin Replaces Belgorod and Bryansk Governors
stories.summary: President Putin replaced the governors of both Belgorod and Bryansk, two Russian regions bordering Ukraine. He appointed a military general and a former official from occupied Ukrainian territory to lead the border regions.

stories.title: Putin Replaces Governors of 2 Regions Bordering Ukraine
stories.summary: The Kremlin replaced the governors of Russia's Belgorod and Bryansk regions—Vyacheslav Gladkov and Alexander Bogomaz—both of whom had led their border regions throughout Moscow's war in Ukraine.

stories.title: ​‘Our only crime is being Shia’: Pakistani workers say UAE surveillance led to deportations
stories.summary: Thousands of Pakistani Shia Muslim workers report being deported from the UAE during the Iran war, alleging that surveillance and sectarian profiling by Emirati authorities began well before the conflict.

stories.title: UAE reaffirms diplomacy, rejects confrontation with Iran, advisor says
stories.summary: Anwar Gargash, adviser to the UAE president, said the Emirates remains committed to diplomacy and political solutions with Iran amid regional tensions. He stressed that Arab-Iranian relations should not be based on confrontation, while affirming the UAE's right to defend its sovereignty.

stories.title: Republicans break ranks, but Senate fails to curb Trump’s Iran war powers
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate voted on a bill to restrict President Trump's war powers regarding Iran, but the measure fell short. Several Republican senators, including Lisa Murkowski, Rand Paul, and Susan Collins, broke with their party to support the resolution, which failed 49-50.

stories.title: Saudi airstrikes targeted militias in Iraq during war with Iran
stories.summary: Saudi warplanes reportedly carried out airstrikes against Iran-backed militias in Iraq, targeting key sites as part of escalating Gulf tensions during the ongoing Saudi-Iranian conflict.

stories.title: Kremlin says Russia can do business with US if it stops linking trade to Ukraine
stories.summary: The Kremlin stated that Russia is open to joint economic projects with the United States, provided Washington stops linking trade ties to a peace deal on Ukraine. The remarks signal Moscow's interest in separating commercial relations from the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Russia renews hardline demands for ending Ukraine war
stories.summary: Russia renewed hardline demands for ending the war in Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky rejected the conditions, stating that accepting them would amount to surrender.

stories.title: Warsh confirmed as Federal Reserve chair, as US central bank faces Trump assault
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate voted 54–45 to confirm Kevin Warsh as the new Federal Reserve chairman, replacing Jerome Powell. The confirmation followed party lines, with Republican support securing President Donald Trump's nominee. Warsh, once considered an inflation hawk, faces a central bank contending with three-year-high inflation and presidential pressure to cut interest rates.

stories.title: Russia unleashes massive drone barrage on Ukraine killing six
stories.summary: Russia launched a large-scale daytime drone attack across multiple areas of Ukraine, killing at least six people.

stories.title: Two Russian governors near Ukraine border step down in Kremlin shake-up
stories.summary: Vyacheslav Gladkov resigned as governor of Russia's Belgorod region, citing personal reasons, according to the Kremlin's press service via Interfax. A second governor of a region bordering Ukraine also stepped down in what appears to be a Kremlin-directed leadership reshuffle.

stories.title: Fedorov, Pistorius visit Ukraine's frontline regions
stories.summary: Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius jointly visited front-line regions in Ukraine to assess conditions on the ground.

stories.title: Iraqi military debunks claims of Israeli base in Karbala desert
stories.summary: Iraq's military escorted journalists to a desert site between Najaf and Karbala that U.S. and Israeli media had described as a secret Israeli base. Iraqi officials firmly denied the claim.

stories.title: Czech police hunting for thief who stole medieval saint's skull from church
stories.summary: Czech police are searching for a thief who stole a medieval saint's skull from a church and have appealed to the public for information to help locate the suspect and the relic.

stories.title: Hungary’s new government summons Russian envoy after strike on Zakarpattia
stories.summary: Hungary's new government summoned Russia's ambassador after Russian drones struck Ukraine's Zakarpattia region, which borders Hungary, just days after the government took office.

stories.title: Iran now defines Strait of Hormuz as far larger zone, IRGC officer says
stories.summary: An Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officer announced on May 12, 2026, that Iran has expanded its operational definition of the Strait of Hormuz to encompass a larger zone. The redefinition broadens the area Iran considers under its strategic purview.

stories.title: Dominican Republic designates Iran’s IRGC, Hezbollah as terrorist organizations
stories.summary: The Dominican Republic officially designated Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Hezbollah as terrorist organizations. The decision was made under the framework of the Inter-American Convention against Terrorism.

stories.title: Heavy rain, hailstorm lash Lahore, inundating low-lying areas
stories.summary: Heavy rain and hailstorms struck Lahore, Pakistan, on Wednesday, inundating low-lying areas and disrupting traffic. The Lakshmi Chowk area recorded the highest rainfall at 95 millimetres, according to Lahore's Water and Sanitation Agency.

stories.title: Netanyahu reveals he secretly visited UAE during Iran war, hails ‘historic breakthrough’
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu revealed he secretly visited the UAE on March 26, meeting the Emirati president in a city near the Oman border during the war with Iran. The trip marks his first confirmed visit to the Gulf state.

stories.title: UAE-owned tanker leaks some fuel off Oman following Iranian strike
stories.summary: A tanker owned by a unit of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company leaked a small amount of fuel off the coast of Oman after being struck by Iranian drones the previous week. The incident highlights the ecological risks arising from the Iran war in the region.

stories.title: Global fire outbreaks hit record high as ‘unprecedented’ heat extremes loom, scientists say
stories.summary: Scientists are warning that climate change combined with El Niño conditions could drive global wildfire outbreaks to record levels this year. Researchers describe the anticipated heat extremes as unprecedented.

stories.title: Valdo Calocane brother tells inquiry he felt powerless over killer’s mental ill health
stories.summary: Elias Calocane testified at an inquiry that he felt powerless over the mental health deterioration of his brother Valdo Calocane, who killed three people in Nottingham in June 2023. Valdo, diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia in 2020, stabbed Barnaby Webber, Grace O'Malley-Kumar, and Ian Coates. Elias said he interpreted his brother's violent messages as suicidal rather than homicidal.

stories.title: From anti-Israel Legos to fake footage, Iran’s AI propaganda owns the digital battlefield
stories.summary: Iran has been using artificial intelligence to produce propaganda content, including AI-generated songs and fabricated footage, reportedly outperforming Israel's own digital influence efforts online.

stories.title: Britain to legislate to tackle threats from hostile state proxies
stories.summary: Britain announced plans to introduce legislation targeting threats from hostile state proxies. The country's security chiefs have identified Iran, Russia, and China as sources of such threats.

stories.title: Russian drone attack: 23 strikes recorded on railway infrastructure facilities
stories.summary: Russian drone attacks struck 23 railway infrastructure facilities across Ukraine, disrupting transportation networks in a targeted assault on the country's logistics capabilities.

stories.title: Will the boycott of Eurovision have any impact?
stories.summary: Five nations have announced a boycott of the Eurovision Song Contest in response to Israel's military campaign in Gaza.

stories.title: Russia continues Ukraine attacks as Trump talks of possible peace
stories.summary: Russia launched a fresh wave of drone attacks against Ukraine on Wednesday, continuing its strikes even as US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin discussed a possible end to the conflict.

stories.title: ECP warns of hearing if prerequisites for Islamabad local govt polls not met
stories.summary: Pakistan's Election Commission directed the interior ministry and Islamabad administration to issue notifications on town corporation limits and union councils for local government elections. Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja warned the matter could be fixed for a hearing if no progress is made.

stories.title: Vatican warns rebel Catholic group it risks excommunication
stories.summary: The Vatican warned a rebel Catholic group that it risks excommunication. Excommunication would mean complete separation from the Church.

stories.title: Hamas must disarm, not ‘disappear’ from Gaza: Board of Peace’s Mladenov
stories.summary: Nickolay Mladenov, head of the Board of Peace overseeing the US-brokered truce in Gaza, stated that Hamas must disarm but acknowledged it need not disappear as a political movement.

stories.title: WATCH: Israel hits Hezbollah terror infrastructure in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: The Israel Defense Forces struck Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon. Hezbollah responded by pledging to remain active on the battlefield and to end Israel-Lebanon ceasefire negotiations.

stories.title: Has the Iran War Sealed the Fate of Power of Siberia 2?
stories.summary: The Power of Siberia 2 pipeline between Russia and China remains stalled despite Gazprom having signed a legally binding memorandum with Beijing. Analysts question whether the ongoing Iran conflict and global energy crisis have affected the project's prospects.

stories.title: Ukraine has become security guarantor that prevented Russian advance into Europe – expert
stories.summary: Geopolitical analyst Jonathan Fink described Ukraine as a security guarantor for Europe, arguing that Ukrainian resistance has prevented Russian forces from advancing deeper into the continent. He also assessed that a Russian invasion of the Baltic states would be ineffective.

stories.title: Netanyahu visited UAE in ‘secret’ during US-Israel war on Iran, office says
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office disclosed that he made a secret visit to the United Arab Emirates during the US-Israel military campaign against Iran, describing the trip as a historic breakthrough in relations.

stories.title: There’s an app for that: Gaza’s developers use tech to solve war problems
stories.summary: Young software developers in Gaza are building practical mobile applications to help residents navigate daily challenges caused by the ongoing conflict and destruction of infrastructure.

stories.title: Don't mention the war: Tucson prepares to welcome Team Iran for World Cup
stories.summary: Tucson, Arizona, is preparing to host Iran's national football team at the Kino Sports Complex as a base camp for the upcoming FIFA World Cup in the US, Mexico, and Canada. The hospitality comes amid ongoing US-Iran tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and broader geopolitical friction.

stories.title: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro deadlocked in presidential runoff poll
stories.summary: A Quaest poll commissioned by brokerage Genial showed Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro statistically tied in a simulated presidential runoff. The survey was published ahead of Brazil's upcoming presidential election.

stories.title: Mexico’s Claudia Sheinbaum denies reports of CIA operations against cartels
stories.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum denied reports by CNN and The New York Times alleging CIA operations against drug cartels inside Mexico, calling the claims a lie.

stories.title: Living under stress: The invisible toll of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict - opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece examines the pervasive psychological stress experienced by populations living under the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, affecting people across the region.

stories.title: Two killed in Israeli attack in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Two people were killed and one injured in an Israeli airstrike on the town of Al-Abbasiya in southern Lebanon's Tyre district, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.

stories.title: Kevin Warsh confirmed as new US Federal Reserve chair amid controversy
stories.summary: The US Senate confirmed Kevin Warsh, President Trump's nominee, as the new chair of the Federal Reserve amid concerns about the central bank's independence.

stories.title: Benjamin Netanyahu made secret trip to UAE at height of the Iran war
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu revealed he traveled covertly to the UAE at the height of the Iran war to meet President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Netanyahu's office described the visit as leading to a "historic breakthrough" in Israeli-UAE relations, marking the latest milestone in a developing Middle East alliance.

stories.title: US Senate confirms Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair, replacing Jerome Powell
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate confirmed Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair by a 54–45 vote, largely along party lines, with Democratic Senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania joining the Republican majority. Warsh was confirmed for a four-year term as chair and a 14-year appointment on the Fed's rate-setting board, succeeding Jerome Powell.

stories.title: Trump arrives in China for talks with Xi
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump arrived in China for talks with President Xi Jinping. The two leaders last met face-to-face in October 2025 in Busan, South Korea.

stories.title: Zelensky: Missile launches possible after waves of Russian drone strikes across Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned, citing intelligence data, that Russian missile launches may follow the ongoing waves of drone strikes hitting multiple regions across Ukraine.

stories.title: Iran hangs man on Israel spy charges, sixth since war started
stories.summary: Iran executed a man on charges of spying for Israel, the sixth such execution since the war began. The individual, identified as Afreshteh, was described as a Mossad-trained operative who sold sensitive information to Israel.

stories.title: Trump arrives in Beijing for high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump arrived in Beijing for a high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, the first visit by a US president to China in nearly a decade. Discussions are expected to cover Iran, trade, and Taiwan.

stories.title: Hamas can survive politically by giving up weapons and armed conflict, peace envoy says
stories.summary: Board of Peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov suggested Hamas could survive as a political movement if it relinquishes weapons and armed conflict. He also warned that the stalemate over Donald Trump's peace plan risks a permanent territorial division in Gaza.

stories.title: Punjab CM Office denies RTI requests seeking details of Maryam's tours and vehicles, luxury jet acquired by govt
stories.summary: The Punjab chief minister's office in Pakistan denied right-to-information requests from a lawyer seeking details about Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz's foreign visits, official vehicles, and a luxury aircraft acquired by the provincial government.

stories.title: Herzog calls on Netanyahu to accept his proposal for plea bargain talks
stories.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog urged Prime Minister Netanyahu to accept his proposal for plea bargain negotiations, saying agreements are the only way to resolve the legal case. The attorney general has agreed to talks, but Netanyahu's legal team has not publicly responded.

stories.title: King’s Speech outlines U.K. govt. agenda as Starmer’s future hangs in the balance
stories.summary: The King's Speech outlined the UK government's legislative agenda, with Prime Minister Keir Starmer facing political uncertainty. The speech reaffirmed Britain's commitment to NATO as "unbreakable."

stories.title: There’s No Need to Fear China’s Economy
stories.summary: An analysis argues that China's economy is not positioned to easily escalate an economic confrontation with the United States. The piece suggests Beijing faces significant constraints that limit its ability to sustain a prolonged economic struggle with Washington.

stories.title: L3Harris turns handheld radios into counter-drone jammers
stories.summary: Defense contractor L3Harris announced a forthcoming software update called Wraith Shield for its handheld radios that converts them into counter-drone jammers. The update uses existing radio antennas to scan for drone control signals, identify hostile ones, and jam them.

stories.title: Israel’s Netanyahu made ‘secret’ visit to UAE during Iran war
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office disclosed that he made a secret visit to the United Arab Emirates on March 26, meeting UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed in the city of Al-Ain. The meeting, held during the ongoing Iran war, was described as producing a "historic breakthrough" in Israeli-UAE relations.

stories.title: How US donor bodies were sold for Israeli military training
stories.summary: An investigation found that cadavers donated to US universities were transferred and used in Israeli military surgical training programs.

stories.title: Taiwan vs China: Is conflict inevitable?
stories.summary: U.S. President Trump met Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing in a historic summit addressing trade, technology, and tensions over Taiwan. China claims Taiwan as its territory while the U.S. continues military and diplomatic support for the island.

stories.title: US Army abruptly cancels deployment of 4,000 soldiers to Poland
stories.summary: The U.S. Army abruptly canceled a planned deployment of approximately 4,000 soldiers to Poland. The cancellation brings American troop levels in Europe back to pre-2022 figures, before Russia's invasion of Ukraine prompted a significant buildup of U.S. forces on the continent.

stories.title: British regulator fines suicide forum over $1.6 million, warns of UK block
stories.summary: UK regulator Ofcom fined a US-based internet suicide forum over £950,000 under the Online Safety Act and warned it could block UK access to the site. The forum has been implicated in more than 160 deaths in the United Kingdom and was found to contain content encouraging or assisting suicide.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz to undertake official three-day China visit: DPM Dar
stories.summary: Pakistani Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar announced that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif will undertake an official three-day visit to China from May 23 to 26, including attendance at a B2B forum. The visit follows President Zardari's recent five-day trip to China.

stories.title: ‘Ungovernable’?: Britain’s once-stable politics in question amid leadership crisis
stories.summary: Britain faces questions about political stability amid a leadership crisis, with public frustration over frequent changes in prime ministers in recent years. The situation has raised broader concerns about governance in the country.

stories.title: Russian drone hits residential building in Ivano-Frankivsk, injuries reported
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck a residential building in Ivano-Frankivsk, a city in western Ukraine. Injuries were reported as a result of the attack.

stories.title: MK Simcha Rothman rushes bill to split A-G position as Knesset dissolution looms - report
stories.summary: MK Simcha Rothman is reportedly fast-tracking a bill to split Israel's Attorney General position as Knesset dissolution approaches. Rabbi Dov Lando, spiritual leader of the Degel Hatorah faction, gave approval to pursue dissolving the Knesset promptly.

stories.title: Britain’s Former Defense Secretary Is Now a Wanted Man in Russia
stories.summary: Russia has reportedly issued an arrest warrant for former British Defense Secretary Ben Wallace, connected to comments he made at the Warsaw Security Forum. British police have not confirmed the warrant.

stories.title: Drug counselor who delivered ketamine dose that killed Matthew Perry gets two years
stories.summary: Erik Fleming, a 56-year-old licensed drug addiction counselor, was sentenced to two years in federal prison in Los Angeles for delivering the ketamine doses that killed actor Matthew Perry in 2023. Fleming had previously pleaded guilty. Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett handed down the sentence.

stories.title: Shots heard at Philippine Senate as lawmaker wanted by ICC holds out; no casualties reported
stories.summary: Gunshots were heard at the Philippine Senate building where Senator Ronald dela Rosa, wanted by the International Criminal Court for alleged crimes against humanity tied to former President Rodrigo Duterte's drug war, has been holed up since May 11. No casualties were reported.

stories.title: Israel attacks on Gaza up since Iran truce, as military says Hamas rearming
stories.summary: Israel increased its attacks on Gaza after a truce with Iran, with reports indicating a 35% rise in strikes in April compared to March. The Israeli military cited concerns that Hamas was rearming as justification for the intensified operations.

stories.title: Netanyahu made ‘secret visit’ to the UAE during war with Iran
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu made a secret visit to the UAE during the war on Iran and met with UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed. His office said the visit produced a historic breakthrough in Israeli-UAE relations.

stories.title: Air Force MQ-9 fleet drops to 135 aircraft after Iran combat losses
stories.summary: The U.S. Air Force's MQ-9 Reaper drone fleet has dropped to 135 aircraft following combat losses sustained during operations against Iran. The Air Force is now seeking to replenish its Reaper inventory and develop a cheaper, more expendable replacement unmanned platform.

stories.title: Ghana to evacuate 300 citizens from South Africa after xenophobic attacks
stories.summary: Ghana announced plans to evacuate 300 citizens from South Africa following a wave of xenophobic attacks targeting migrants from sub-Saharan African countries. Ghana's foreign minister confirmed the evacuation plans in a post on the social media platform X.

stories.title: Should politics and culture mix? Eurovision 2026: inside the controversy
stories.summary: Israel's participation in Eurovision 2026 in Vienna has sparked significant controversy, with five nations — including Ireland, the Netherlands, Spain, and Iceland — withdrawing in protest. Contestant Noam Bettan's semi-final performance was met with chants of "Stop the Genocide."

stories.title: Over 10,000 homes destroyed or damaged since ceasefire, Lebanon says
stories.summary: Lebanon's National Council for Scientific Research reported that more than 10,000 homes have been destroyed or damaged since the Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire took effect on April 17. Israel has continued launching heavy air strikes despite the ceasefire.

stories.title: Air Force expects new KC-46 vision system in 2028 as lawmakers question price hike
stories.summary: The U.S. Air Force expects a new vision system for the KC-46 aerial refueling tanker to be delivered by 2028. Senator Kevin Cramer raised concerns about projected cost increases, with budget documents indicating the price could rise by $100 million per aircraft.

stories.title: Explainer-Could cruise ship passengers sue over the hantavirus outbreak?
stories.summary: Passengers affected by a deadly hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship have limited legal options to sue, though the ship's operator could face liability if found to have acted recklessly. The article examines the legal framework governing passenger claims in such maritime incidents.

stories.title: US Senator Cassidy’s vote to convict Trump looms over Louisiana primary
stories.summary: US Senator Bill Cassidy of Louisiana faces a Trump-backed challenger in a primary race, with his 2021 vote to convict Donald Trump during impeachment proceedings becoming a central issue.

stories.title: Israeli tourist killed, four injured in Panama bus crash
stories.summary: An Israeli tourist was killed and four other Israelis were injured in a bus crash in Panama. Israel's ZAKA rescue organization and the Foreign Ministry are working with Panamanian authorities to repatriate the body.

stories.title: Russia launches massive drone assault on Ukraine, preparing new waves of strikes on critical infrastructure – Beskrestnov
stories.summary: Russia launched a large-scale combined attack on Ukraine using hundreds of Shahed strike drones. Analyst Beskrestnov noted a new tactic aimed at overwhelming Ukrainian air defenses along the border with Belarus while preparing further strikes on critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Iran's foreign minister demands immediate release of four Iranians detained in Kuwait
stories.summary: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi demanded the immediate release of four Iranian citizens detained by Kuwait in the Gulf. Kuwait said it arrested four individuals affiliated with Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps who attempted to enter the country by sea.

stories.title: Europe doesn’t make missile defenses at scale. Thirteen countries just joined Ukraine to fix that.
stories.summary: Thirteen European countries and NATO convened in Kyiv on May 12 to launch a coordinated effort to produce anti-ballistic missile defense systems at scale, aiming to reduce dependence on U.S. Patriot systems.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV awards Vatican honour to Iranian ambassador
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV awarded a Vatican honor to Iranian Ambassador Mohammad Hossein Mokhtari. The gesture from the Holy See comes during a period of sustained tensions between the United States and Iran.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV grants Vatican's top diplomatic award to Iran envoy
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV awarded the Vatican's top diplomatic honor to Iranian envoy Mohammad Hossein Mokhtari. The gesture comes amid sustained tensions between the United States and Iran.

stories.title: EU officially signals intent to join Special Tribunal agreement – Sybiha
stories.summary: The European Union officially notified the Council of Europe of its intent to join the agreement establishing a Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine, according to Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha.

stories.title: Berlin Holocaust memorial vandalized in latest antisemitic vandalism incident
stories.summary: The Holocaust memorial in Berlin commemorating 32,000 deported Jews was vandalized again. Previous incidents included the memorial being splashed with white paint and covered in parcel tape in August.

stories.title: Jewish Republican Paul Singer tarred with rainbow Star of David in Kentucky primary ad
stories.summary: U.S. Rep. Thomas Massie ran a Kentucky primary ad against opponent Ed Gallrein that featured donor Paul Singer alongside a rainbow Star of David. Critics called the imagery antisemitic and anti-LGBTQ.

stories.title: Israeli strikes on cars in Lebanon kill 12, including children
stories.summary: Israeli strikes on vehicles across Lebanon killed 12 people, including children, ahead of new U.S.-mediated talks between Beirut and Tel Aviv scheduled in Washington.

stories.title: Pro-Palestine chants disrupt Israel Eurovision performance
stories.summary: Pro-Palestine protesters disrupted Israel's Eurovision semi-final performance in Vienna with loud chants during the contest.

stories.title: Herzog urges negotiations toward plea deal in Netanyahu criminal trial
stories.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog called for dialogue and negotiations toward a possible plea deal in Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's ongoing criminal trial, amid heightened political tensions ahead of elections.

stories.title: Can Naftali Bennett win Israel without belonging to anyone? - analysis
stories.summary: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has announced a political merger with Yair Lapid under the party name Together. Analysts note Bennett has repeatedly used parties—Bayit Yehudi, Yamina, and Bennett 2026—as political vehicles without building a lasting partisan base.

stories.title: Analyzing Trump’s Foreign Policy and Its International Implications
stories.summary: Defense analyst Ben Friedman revisited his 2016 prediction that the Trump administration would adopt a hawkish foreign policy despite non-interventionist campaign rhetoric. The updated analysis examines how structural forces and hawkish appointees have shaped Trump's approach toward Russia, China, and Iran over the past decade.

stories.title: Arrieta beats Eulalio to win epic wet Giro stage
stories.summary: Spain's Igor Arrieta outpaced Portugal's Afonso Eulalio to win stage five of the Giro d'Italia in wet conditions after a breakaway battle.

stories.title: Met warns about hate speech at Unite the Kingdom and Palestine marches
stories.summary: London's Metropolitan Police warned that organisers and speakers at both the Unite the Kingdom and March for Palestine demonstrations this weekend will be held responsible for any hate speech. Tens of thousands are expected to attend both events.

stories.title: Trump-Xi summit: China’s help in Iran may require US concessions
stories.summary: Analysts suggest China may seek changes to U.S. policy on Taiwan in exchange for pressuring Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, as Trump and Xi prepare for summit talks.

stories.title: IDF preparing plan to return to Gaza fighting, depending on Iran ceasefire deal
stories.summary: An Israeli security source told Walla that a last-minute ceasefire agreement with Iran could bring Israel closer to resuming military operations against Hamas in the Gaza Strip. The IDF is reportedly preparing contingency plans accordingly.

stories.title: At Least 3 Killed in Russian Drone Attacks Across Ukraine
stories.summary: Russian drone attacks killed at least three people across Ukraine in rare daytime strikes that largely targeted western regions of the country.

stories.title: Drone attack on Rivne region: Death toll rises to three, six people injured
stories.summary: Three people were killed and six injured in the Rivne region of western Ukraine as a result of a large-scale Russian drone attack.

stories.title: Modest gains in GDP, per capita income indicate recovery in output, government says
stories.summary: Pakistan's government reported that GDP is expected to grow by 3.70% in the current fiscal year, revised down from an earlier 4% projection. Per capita income and GDP increased modestly in dollar terms. Provisional growth rates for agriculture, industry, and services in FY26 stand at 2.89%, 3.51%, and 4.09%, respectively.

stories.title: Israel seizes more areas of Gaza, expanding control to 64%
stories.summary: Israel expanded its territorial control in Gaza to 64% after seizing an additional 11% of the Strip's territory. A new demarcation dubbed the "Orange Line" was established with the endorsement of Donald Trump's Board of Peace.

stories.title: Israelis storm Joseph’s Tomb in Nablus as 'heritage' bill passed
stories.summary: Thousands of Israeli settlers, led by Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, stormed Joseph's Tomb in Nablus. The incursion coincided with the Knesset passing a bill to seize control of West Bank heritage sites.

stories.title: 1953: The CIA led coup that still shapes Iran | Turning Point
stories.summary: A documentary revisits the 1953 CIA- and British-backed coup that overthrew Iranian Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh after he nationalized Iran's oil industry in 1951. The event continues to shape Iran's political landscape.

stories.title: 1st vote on bill to dissolve Knesset likely next week as coalition jockeys to control early elections timing
stories.summary: Israel's opposition sought to trigger early elections after an ultra-Orthodox faction called for dissolving the Knesset. The ruling coalition is reportedly preparing a rival bill to control the timing of any early vote. A first vote is expected next week.

stories.title: Israeli attack wounds Palestinians in northern Gaza
stories.summary: The Palestinian Red Crescent Society reported that several Palestinians, including children, were wounded by Israeli forces in Beit Lahia in the northern Gaza Strip.

stories.title: Lufthansa group and Wizz Air to resume Tel Aviv flights after three-month war hiatus
