stories.summary: Pakistan's Higher Education Commission (HEC) launched a fully online and paperless degree attestation system. The initiative integrates blockchain technology and follows demands from a National Assembly committee to reduce processing times for degree verification.

stories.title: Former Anti-Corruption Foundation director says Team Navalny’s leadership has abandoned its core principles
stories.summary: Ivan Zhdanov, former director of Russia's Anti-Corruption Foundation (FBK), gave an interview criticizing the organization's current leadership for abandoning its core principles. He also described how he organized the transfer of Alexei Navalny's biological samples to Western laboratories, which confirmed the politician was poisoned.

stories.title: From local election loss to Mandelson fiasco, Starmer must go
stories.summary: Labour's poor performance in UK local elections and controversy over Peter Mandelson's appointment have raised serious questions about Prime Minister Keir Starmer's leadership and political judgment.

stories.title: In double trouble: Iran’s oil crisis – opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece argues that Iran's oil sector is under severe pressure, suggesting the Islamic Republic should heed historical warnings that economic collapse often begins with such indicators.

stories.title: How rumours of ‘genital shrinking’ triggered panic and mob violence in Congo
stories.summary: The WHO-backed Africa Infodemic Response Alliance later linked at least 17 killings to the rumours, though some incidents could not be independently verified

stories.title: Iran warns of ‘well-deserved response to any aggression'
stories.summary: Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that Iran's armed forces are prepared to deliver a "well-deserved response to any aggression," as tensions with the United States escalated following Trump's remarks that the ceasefire was on "life support."

stories.title: Air Assault Forces training center identifies key problem among mobilized recruits during intensive training
stories.summary: Ukraine's 199th Training Center of the Air Assault Forces reported that chronic health conditions going undetected during military medical exams are a major problem among mobilized recruits. The issue was identified during intensive training programs for newly conscripted personnel.

stories.title: Lawsuit blames ChatGPT maker OpenAI for helping plan Florida university shooting
stories.summary: The widow of a victim killed in last year's mass shooting at Florida State University has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. Authorities disclosed that ChatGPT provided the shooter with advice on timing, location, and weapons to maximize casualties.

stories.title: EU imposes sanctions on Russia individuals, entities in Russia over Ukrainian children
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, May 11 - The European Union has imposed sanctions on 16 individuals and seven entities in Russia for systematic unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children, the EU Council said in a statement

stories.title: Iran and the U.S. are at an impasse ahead of Trump’s China trip
stories.summary: Iran and the United States have reached an impasse again over how to end their war

stories.title: Sybiha, Rutte discuss ways to scale up Ukrainian arms manufacturing with NATO support
stories.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte met in Brussels to discuss scaling up arms manufacturing in Ukraine. The talks focused on leveraging NATO's industrial base to boost Ukrainian weapons production capacity.

stories.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
stories.summary: The European Union approved sanctions targeting Israeli settlers accused of violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. EU foreign policy chief stated that extremism carries consequences, while Israel condemned the measures as arbitrary.

stories.title: Italy's Culture Ministry rocked by dismissals as Meloni struggles to reshape landscape
stories.summary: ROME, May 11 - Italy's Culture Minister Alessandro Giuli has sacked two senior aides after uproar over denied funding for a documentary, adding to turbulence at a ministry already shaken by months of

stories.title: Ben Gurion operating like ‘a US military base’, Israel aviation chief warns
stories.summary: Israel's civil aviation chief Shmuel Zakay warned that Ben Gurion Airport is functioning like a US military base, raising concerns about disruptions to civilian flights and the return of foreign airlines to Israeli airspace.

stories.title: As Hungary’s new PM, Magyar’s hunt for Orban’s protégés has already begun
stories.summary: New Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar immediately called on the country's president to resign upon taking office on Saturday. The move signals Magyar's intent to dismantle former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán's network of loyalists throughout Hungarian institutions.

stories.title: EU ministers agree on sanctions targeting violent West Bank settlers
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers agreed on new sanctions targeting three violent Israeli settlers and four settler organizations in the occupied West Bank, as well as leading Hamas figures. The package had been blocked for months by Hungary's previous government, which lost power in a recent election.

stories.title: Pakistan protests to Afghanistan over suicide attack that killed 15 officers
stories.summary: Pakistan has summoned a senior Afghan diplomat to protest a suicide attack in its northwest that killed 15 police officers

stories.title: Pro-Palestine camp to take place at site of Jewish WWII deportations
stories.summary: A pro-Palestine encampment is planned at Moorweide in Hamburg, Germany, a historic site from which approximately 6,000 Jews, Sinti, and Roma were deported during the Holocaust.

stories.title: One million US dollars in federal grants awarded to California Jewish security initiative
stories.summary: US Congressman Brad Sherman secured one million dollars in federal grants for a California Jewish community security initiative, having originally requested $1.4 million from the House Appropriations Committee for fiscal year 2026.

stories.title: Hundreds of millions seized in raid in northern Israel
stories.summary: Israeli authorities seized hundreds of millions of shekels in a raid in northern Israel. The suspects were detained by the National Economic Crimes Unit on suspicion of money laundering and terror financing.

stories.title: Ukraine has built world’s most battle-tested defense industry. Berlin plugs in with “Brave Germany”
stories.summary: Germany and Ukraine signed a joint defense technology program called "Brave Germany," with Berlin already funding approximately one-third of Ukraine's defense production efforts.

stories.title: Trump to visit China for high-stakes talks with Xi Jinping
stories.summary: President Donald Trump is scheduled to visit China from May 13 to 15 for talks with President Xi Jinping. Trade, the Iran conflict, and regional security are expected to dominate the agenda.

stories.title: Lawsuit seeks to halt Trump's makeover of Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool
stories.summary: The Cultural Landscape Foundation filed a lawsuit to block President Trump's renovation of the Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool in Washington, D.C. The suit alleges the project violates the National Historic Preservation Act of 1996.

stories.title: Birmingham jury fails to convict pro-Palestine activist accused of supporting Hamas
stories.summary: A jury at Birmingham Crown Court was unable to convict Palestinian activist Majid Freeman, also known as Majid Novsarka, on charges of encouraging terrorism and supporting Hamas based on social media posts. A retrial has been ordered.

stories.title: Two held in Sweden over suspected deliveries of hi-tech gear to Russia
stories.summary: STOCKHOLM, May 11 - Two people have been detained in Sweden on suspicion of helping Russia procure advanced engineering products that could be used in Moscow's war in Ukraine, the Swedish security ser

stories.title: Could the latest violence in DR Congo undermine truce efforts?
stories.summary: Lesser-known armed groups have carried out a series of attacks in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The violence raises concerns about whether ongoing truce efforts in the country could be undermined.

stories.title: Russia intensifies FPV drone attacks in Southern Ukraine, military spox says
stories.summary: Russian forces significantly escalated combat operations in southern Ukraine last week, conducting nearly 200 assault attacks. The military reported a sharp increase in the use of kamikaze and first-person-view (FPV) drones in the region.

stories.title: Trump says he will discuss arms sales to Taiwan in meeting with China’s Xi
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump stated he plans to discuss arms sales to Taiwan during an upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Washington's weapons sales to Taipei have long been a source of friction with Beijing, which claims Taiwan as its territory.

stories.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli West Bank settlers, Hamas leaders
stories.summary: The European Union reached agreement on sanctions targeting both Israeli West Bank settlers and Hamas leaders. The deal was made possible after Hungary's newly installed government dropped the veto that had previously blocked the measures.

stories.title: Iraqi PM-designate caught between US endorsement, militia violence - report
stories.summary: Iraq's prime minister-designate Ali al-Zaidi faces pressure from the United States to exclude Iran-backed militias from his potential government. Reports indicate that such a move could provoke violent pushback from those armed groups.

stories.title: Why Iran's ballistic missiles pose a greater threat than the nuclear issue - analysis
stories.summary: An analysis highlights that Iran's ballistic missile capabilities may pose a greater immediate threat than its nuclear program. Iran reportedly surprised both Israel and the United States by rapidly excavating and restoring underground missile sites that had been bombed.

stories.title: Air Force MQ-9 downs aerial targets with cheap air-to-air missiles
stories.summary: The US Air Force demonstrated an MQ-9 Reaper drone shooting down aerial targets using low-cost air-to-air missiles. The test is part of the service's effort to develop affordable defenses against inexpensive enemy drones.

stories.title: NA passes unanimous resolution hailing military's 'befitting response' to India in May conflict
stories.summary: Pakistan's National Assembly unanimously passed a resolution praising the armed forces' response to India's military aggression during the May 2025 conflict. The conflict, spanning from the April 22 Pahalgam attack through the May 10 ceasefire, has been officially designated "Marka-i-Haq" by the Pakistani state.

stories.title: Report: Ukraine proposes splitting military recruitment offices, setting fixed service terms
stories.summary: Ukraine is considering proposals to restructure its military recruitment offices and establish fixed service terms. The discussions follow President Zelensky's replacement of the defense minister with Mykhailo Fedorov in January 2026 and a promised major stage of army reform announced in May.

stories.title: 'Macron always been a strong believer in the importance of Africa as a partner for the future'
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is co-hosting the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi, Kenya, marking the first time France has held such an event in an English-speaking African nation. Chatham House fellow Paul Melly described it as part of a longer strategic effort to rebalance France's engagement beyond its traditional Francophone partners following setbacks in the Sahel.

stories.title: Ukraine is preparing military contracts with guaranteed demobilization rights and combat pay up to $9,100 per month
stories.summary: Ukraine is preparing new military contracts that would offer combat pay of up to $9,100 per month and guaranteed demobilization rights, representing a significant potential reform for soldiers mobilized since 2022.

stories.title: World losing 100 million barrels a week of oil with Hormuz closed, Saudi Aramco chief says
stories.summary: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser warned that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz is costing the world approximately 100 million barrels of oil per week, citing a disconnect between oil futures prices and physical supply realities.

stories.title: South Africa: Johannesburg Faces a Total Financial Collapse While Executive Pay Soars
stories.summary: South Africa's Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana warned that the City of Johannesburg is in financial crisis and cannot fulfill a R10 billion wage deal with the Samwu labor union, effectively confirming the city's bankruptcy.

stories.title: Ukraine, Germany working on six joint weapons production projects – Zelensky
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius discussed six joint weapons production projects between Ukraine and Germany. The talks also covered a long-term Drone Deal and German support for Ukraine's air defense and energy infrastructure.

stories.title: The US is ignoring Iran’s religious agenda at its own peril - opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece argues that the Trump administration is underestimating Iran's religious motivations, specifically the influence of Twelver Shia theology on the country's ruling elite. The author warns that failing to account for this ideological dimension undermines U.S. policy.

stories.title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation coverage of Gaza war fueled antisemitism, ABC Watch claims
stories.summary: ABC Watch alleged that the Australian Broadcasting Corporation's coverage of the Gaza war contributed to rising antisemitism in Australia. The group argued the publicly funded broadcaster has a legal obligation to report impartially and objectively.

stories.title: Netanyahu defends Mossad chief pick after reportedly blasting Barnea for opposition
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended his nomination of Roman Gofman as the next Mossad chief, suggesting that opposition to the pick, including reportedly from outgoing chief David Barnea, stemmed from political considerations rather than qualifications.

stories.title: EU ministers reject Putin's idea of role for Schroeder in future security talks
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, May 11 - European governments on Monday rejected suggestion by Russian President Vladimir Putin that German former Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder could represent them in possible future talks

stories.title: Saab launches new Carl-Gustaf, air defense munitions, expands production in US, India
stories.summary: Swedish defense company Saab announced new Carl-Gustaf warheads and air defense munitions. The firm also provided delivery timeline details for production facilities it is expanding in the United States and India.

stories.title: Israeli soldiers jailed for desecration of Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
stories.summary: Two Israeli soldiers were sentenced to military prison for desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in southern Lebanon, where one placed a cigarette in the statue's mouth while the other photographed it. The viral image sparked widespread outrage over anti-Christian acts by Israeli forces.

stories.title: Bosnian Serb jailed for wartime killing of Muslims
stories.summary: Dusko Zoric, a Bosnian Serb, was convicted and jailed for killing five Muslims during the 1990s Bosnian war. He was extradited from Germany in 2025 to face justice.

stories.title: Lithuania backs Strait of Hormuz mission with just 40 troops
stories.summary: Lithuania's State Defence Council approved deploying up to 40 personnel, including troops and civilian defence staff, to join an international mission protecting shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The decision was confirmed by the president's office on Monday.

stories.title: Ukraine anti-corruption agencies serve suspicion notice to ex-Presidential Office head Yermak over alleged $10M laundering
stories.summary: Ukraine's National Anti-Corruption Bureau and Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office served a formal suspicion notice to Andriy Yermak, former head of the Presidential Office, over an alleged $10 million money laundering scheme.

stories.title: EU and UK sanction organizers of militarization of Ukrainian children in occupied territories
stories.summary: The United Kingdom and the European Union imposed new sanctions on Russian organizations and officials accused of Russifying and militarizing Ukrainian children in occupied territories. The measures also target individuals coordinating Russian information operations.

stories.title: Exclusive: Emmanuel Macron interview on FRANCE 24, Tuesday May 12 at 9pm
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron will give an interview to FRANCE 24, RFI, and TV5Monde journalists in Nairobi, Kenya, on Tuesday, May 12, following the conclusion of the Africa Forward Summit.

stories.title: Kenya summit represents 'demarcation point': France 'wants to do business' with African continent
stories.summary: President Emmanuel Macron and Kenyan President William Ruto co-hosted the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi. Analysts describe the event as a turning point for French diplomacy in Africa, as Paris seeks to redefine its continental role after military ruptures in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger and growing Russian and Chinese influence.

stories.title: Iranian protesters accosted by pro-Palestinian mobs
stories.summary: Kosar Eftekhari, an Iranian woman who lost an eye after being shot by the Iranian regime, was attacked by pro-regime protesters during a demonstration in Germany. The incident highlights tensions between Iranian diaspora protesters and regime supporters abroad.

stories.title: Iron Dome nearly 99% effective against incoming missiles, maker Rafael's chairman says
stories.summary: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems chairman stated that Israel's Iron Dome missile defense system has achieved nearly 99% effectiveness against missiles fired by Hamas and Hezbollah. The system has also intercepted most missiles launched from Iran.

stories.title: EU foreign ministers approve sanctions on violent Israeli settlers, Hamas leaders
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers approved sanctions targeting violent Israeli settlers and Hamas leaders after Hungary's new leadership lifted its longstanding veto on the measure. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar rejected the decision.

stories.title: India expects the U.S. team to visit India for next round of trade talks, say officials
stories.summary: India and the U.S. issued a joint statement on February 7 finalising a framework for an interim trade agreement regarding reciprocal and mutually beneficial trade

stories.title: Trump vows to pause federal gas tax after Iran war boosts US fuel prices to four-year high
stories.summary: President Trump pledged to suspend the federal gas tax after U.S. fuel prices reached a four-year high. The national average has risen by over a dollar per gallon since late February, when U.S. and Israeli forces launched military operations against Iran.

stories.title: Elon Musk and Tim Cook among CEOs expected to accompany Trump on China trip
stories.summary: Seventeen US corporate executives, including Elon Musk and Apple CEO Tim Cook, are expected to accompany President Trump on his trip to China. The delegation will attend meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: UK sanctions network accused of planning attacks for Iran
stories.summary: The United Kingdom imposed asset freezes and travel bans on a network accused of laundering billions of dollars and planning hostile operations on behalf of Iran on British soil.

stories.title: Imaan, Hadi submit additional documents ahead of hearing on appeals in apex court tomorrow
stories.summary: ISLAMABAD: Human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, have submitted additional documents to the Supreme Court of Pakistan, bringing these on record before the he

stories.title: Philippine senator flees ICC arrest over role in Duterte’s drug war
stories.summary: Philippine Senator Ronald Dela Rosa evaded arrest on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court related to his role in former President Rodrigo Duterte's drug war campaign.

stories.title: Germany views Putin’s Schröder ceasefire proposal part of Russia’s hybrid strategy aimed at dividing West. It could consider him on one condition
stories.summary: German officials dismissed former Chancellor Gerhard Schröder's ceasefire proposal on behalf of Russian President Vladimir Putin, viewing it as part of Russia's hybrid strategy aimed at dividing Western allies.

stories.title: Ben Gvir calls EU ‘antisemitic’ as bloc sanctions Israeli settlers
stories.summary: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir accused the European Union of antisemitism after the bloc imposed sanctions on Israeli settlers linked to violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. Ben Gvir dismissed the EU's actions as biased.

stories.title: SC dismisses appeals against SHC order in TRG shareholding dispute
stories.summary: The Supreme Court (SC) on Monday dismissed a set of appeals instituted by Greentree Holdings Limited (GTH) against a June order by the Sindh High Court (SHC), which had held that GTH shares were the p

stories.title: Bolivia’s Evo Morales held in contempt after missing court in trafficking trial
stories.summary: A Bolivian judge held former President Evo Morales in contempt after he failed to appear in court for his trial on charges of trafficking a minor. Morales, who served as Bolivia's first indigenous president from 2006 to 2019, is accused of having a relationship with a teenager during his presidency.

stories.title: From “drone killers” to virtual reality: Air Assault Forces reveal new standards in troop training
stories.summary: The 199th Training Center of the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces has incorporated virtual reality and computer simulation technologies into its training programs. The technologies are being used during basic combined-arms training and specialized instruction for troops.

stories.title: Zelenskiy says some 20 countries interested in drone deals with Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that nearly 20 countries have expressed interest in drone deals with Ukraine, with four agreements already signed. The announcement underscores Ukraine's growing role as a drone technology exporter.

stories.title: Drug gang attacks ‘force hundreds of Indigenous families to flee’ in Mexico
stories.summary: In Guerrero state, Mexico, the criminal group Los Ardillos has intensified attacks on Indigenous communities, including drone bombings. The National Indigenous Congress reported that between 800 and 1,000 families were forced to flee their mountain villages after hours of sustained bombardment.

stories.title: Woman arrested for allegedly attacking London Jewish school boy
stories.summary: A woman was arrested in London for allegedly punching a Jewish schoolboy and shouting antisemitic abuse during the attack. The incident was reported by the Jewish neighborhood watch group Shomrim on social media.

stories.title: Trump says ceasefire with Iran on ‘life support’ after rejecting peace proposals
stories.summary: President Donald Trump declared the ceasefire with Iran is on "life support" and rejected Iranian peace proposals. He said he is considering restarting U.S. Navy escorts of ships through the Strait of Hormuz to counter an Iranian blockade of the strategic waterway.

stories.title: How impunity in Shireen Abu Akleh’s case fuels Israeli attacks on the press
stories.summary: Rights advocates argue that the lack of accountability for the 2022 killing of Al Jazeera journalist and US citizen Shireen Abu Akleh by Israeli forces has emboldened further attacks on press freedom.

stories.title: What local elections reveal about the future of UK politics
stories.summary: Recent UK local election results revealed growing fragmentation of British politics, with the traditional two-party system weakening. Reform UK and the Green Party made gains, filling the vacuum left by declining support for Labour and the Conservatives.

stories.title: Turkey's foreign minister to visit Qatar for talks on Iran war
stories.summary: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan will visit Qatar on Tuesday for talks on the Iran war and its regional impact. Discussions will also address efforts to ensure navigational safety in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Israel's Knesset backs 'show trial' bill to try 7 Oct defendants
stories.summary: Israel's Knesset passed a bill enabling public trials of defendants connected to the October 7 attacks, with possible death sentences. Rights monitors warned the proceedings could violate international law and amount to show trials.

stories.title: Israel's Knesset backs 'show trial' bill to try 7 Oct attackers
stories.summary: Israel's Knesset approved legislation to publicly try captured October 7 attackers in military tribunals. Human rights organizations have warned that public trials and possible death sentences could violate international law and amount to show trials.

stories.title: Israel votes on controversial public trial bill for Palestinians
stories.summary: The Israeli Knesset voted on a bill that would allow public trials of Palestinian detainees. Human rights organizations including Adalah warned the legislation could violate international law and represent a collapse of the rule of law.

stories.title: PM extends austerity drive till June 13 to deal with impact of Middle East war
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif extended nationwide austerity measures until June 13 to address the economic impact of the Middle East conflict. The measures were first introduced on March 9 in response to a global oil crisis triggered by US-Israeli attacks on Iran beginning February 28.

stories.title: Maldives repays second $50mn Indian treasury bill: President Mohamed Muizzu
stories.summary: India had extended financial support to the Maldives through treasury bills, also called T-Bills, subscribed by the State Bank of India

stories.title: Sudan drone strikes killed at least 880 civilians between January and April: UN
stories.summary: The South Sudan Civil War is entering a deadlier phase, says UN rights chief

stories.title: US op. in Iran would expand beyond escorting vessels in Strait of Hormuz, Trump says
stories.summary: President Trump indicated that a potential U.S. military operation involving Iran could expand beyond escorting vessels through the Strait of Hormuz. He reiterated that the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is on 'life support.'

stories.title: Trump dismisses Iran’s reply to peace plan, oil jumps as Hormuz closure persists
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's response to a peace proposal, causing oil prices to jump. Tehran had demanded compensation for war damage and asserted sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz as part of its response.

stories.title: Buk, Tor, Kasta, Tunguska—Russia’s air defense menu shrinks by $131 million in another seven days
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone forces destroyed an estimated $131 million worth of Russian air defense systems, including Buk, Tor, Kasta, and Tunguska platforms, across occupied Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Russia's Bryansk Oblast in one week.

stories.title: Border guards prevent Russian small assault groups from breaking through in Kharkiv region
stories.summary: Fighters of Ukraine's Hart Border Brigade repelled an attempt by Russian small assault groups to infiltrate positions in the Southern Slobozhanshchyna direction in Kharkiv region. The border guards prevented the Russian forces from breaking through.

stories.title: Israeli strikes hit south Lebanon, killing three and wounding four
stories.summary: Israeli forces carried out multiple strikes across southern Lebanon, killing at least three people and wounding four. A health facility in Srifa was directly struck, killing one, while a drone attack on a vehicle in Doueir killed two others.

stories.title: Trump says ceasefire is on ‘life support’ after rejecting Iran’s proposal
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump declared the ceasefire negotiations with Iran to be on "life support" after rejecting Tehran's latest counterproposal, which he deemed unacceptable.

stories.title: Three ministerial aides quit and demand Keir Starmer’s resignation as speech fails to quell rebellion – UK politics live
stories.summary: Three ministerial aides in the UK resigned and called on Prime Minister Keir Starmer to step down following poor Labour performance in local elections. More than 60 Labour MPs have demanded Starmer set a timetable for his resignation. The rebellion continued despite a speech by the prime minister attempting to reassure his party.

stories.title: Navy unveils three new PAEs for aviation, mission systems, munitions
stories.summary: The US Navy established three new Program and Acquisition Executive offices covering aviation, mission systems, and munitions portfolios. Jason Potter, performing the duties of assistant secretary of the Navy for research and development, said the new PAEs will accelerate acquisition efforts in these key areas.

stories.title: Europe must establish direct contact with Russia — Stubb
stories.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated that European governments should establish direct contact with Moscow. Stubb believes the time has come for Europe to engage directly with Russia.

stories.title: UN warns drone attacks drive surge in civilian deaths in Sudan
stories.summary: The UN human rights chief warned that widening violence in Sudan and the increasing use of drones are driving a surge in civilian deaths. The escalation could lead to further displacement across the conflict-affected country.

stories.title: Sensationalism Doesn’t Serve Society
stories.summary: The Ukraine Compass, a weekly digest for War on the Rocks members, curates commentary and analysis from Ukrainian media to provide perspectives beyond battlefield coverage. The series highlights how Ukrainians themselves debate political, social, and daily-life issues while their country remains at war.

stories.title: EU hits Israel settlers with new sanctions over W. Bank violence
stories.summary: The European Union approved new sanctions targeting Israeli settler groups and individuals accused of perpetrating violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. The measures aim to address escalating settler attacks in the territory.

stories.title: North Korea Has Reaped $13Bln From Military Aid to Russia, South Korean Intelligence Says
stories.summary: South Korean intelligence reports that North Korea has received an estimated $13 billion in benefits from military aid provided to Russia. Pyongyang allegedly received hard currency, energy supplies, and critical military technologies in exchange for weapons and manpower, helping bypass international sanctions.

stories.title: Poland says its expects US to extradite ex-minister who fled from Hungary
stories.summary: Poland's foreign minister Radosław Sikorski stated that Warsaw expects the United States to extradite former Polish justice minister Zbigniew Ziobro, who is wanted on criminal charges. Ziobro reportedly fled to the US from Hungary, where former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán had granted him asylum. President Trump was reportedly involved in securing Ziobro's US visa.

stories.title: UK slaps sanctions on dozen people and entities deemed ‘criminal proxies’ of Iran
stories.summary: The United Kingdom imposed sanctions on 12 individuals and entities described as criminal proxies of Iran. The measures follow a wave of arson attacks allegedly backed by Tehran targeting Jewish sites in London.

stories.title: 5 US bases selected for anti-drone pilot program
stories.summary: The US military has selected five installations for a pilot program testing anti-drone directed-energy systems. Two of the chosen bases are located along the southern border. The program aims to counter the growing threat posed by unmanned aerial systems at military facilities.

stories.title: Turkey’s STM debuts new unmanned systems, is ‘really open’ to Gulf collaboration
stories.summary: Turkish defense firm STM unveiled new unmanned systems and expressed openness to collaboration with Gulf states. The company's general manager said STM is already integrating artificial intelligence, image processing, and machine learning into its platforms and is deepening its investment in those technologies.

stories.title: Newly elected Reform councillor resigns after social media claims
stories.summary: Stuart Prior, a newly elected Reform UK councillor in Essex, resigned days after winning his seat following allegations about his social media posts. He allegedly celebrated the rape of a Sikh woman, declared white people the "master race," and called Muslim people "rats." Prior had received 2,404 votes, the highest total of any candidate in his ward.

stories.title: Trump says ceasefire on ‘life support’, slams Iran response to US proposal
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump described the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran as being on 'life support' and criticized Iran's response to an American peace proposal. Diplomatic efforts between the two sides have repeatedly stalled, raising fears of a return to armed conflict.

stories.title: Water levels on Rhine river in Germany rising after rain, may normalise this week
stories.summary: Rain has raised water levels on the Rhine River in Germany, allowing cargo vessels to carry more freight after shallow water disrupted shipping the previous week. Full cargo loads are still largely not possible, though levels may normalize this week.

stories.title: Trump says Iran deal ‘very possible’ despite fragile ceasefire
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said a diplomatic deal with Iran remains 'very possible' despite previously warning that the ceasefire is on 'life support.' Trump described Iran's leadership as 'very dishonourable' while insisting his administration could still reach an agreement.

stories.title: UK sanctions 12 Iran-linked people, entities
stories.summary: The UK Foreign Office imposed travel bans and asset freezes on nine individuals, two shadow banking exchange houses, and the Zindashti criminal network for alleged links to Iran. The sanctions target those accused of acting as proxies for Tehran.

stories.title: Senate Democrats to fight Republicans’ $1bn funding plan for Trump’s ballroom
stories.summary: US Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer has pledged to oppose a Republican plan to allocate $1 billion for security improvements to a ballroom Donald Trump wants built on the White House's former East Wing. The funding is part of a broader measure that would direct approximately $70 billion to agencies carrying out Trump's mass deportation campaign.

stories.title: IDF soldier sentenced to 21 days in military prison after defacing Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
stories.summary: An IDF soldier received a 21-day military prison sentence for defacing a Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon. A second soldier was sentenced to 14 days for filming the incident.

stories.title: War update: 38 combat clashes since morning, Pokrovsk direction remains most active
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces recorded 38 combat clashes with Russian troops since morning, with the Pokrovsk direction in eastern Ukraine remaining the most active sector of fighting.

stories.title: Levin's refusal to meet with Supreme Court harms Israeli public, judiciary, AG argues
stories.summary: Israel's Attorney General argued that Knesset Speaker Yariv Levin's refusal to meet with the Supreme Court constitutes a severe infringement by the executive branch on the judiciary, harming the Israeli public.

stories.title: Pressure on Starmer mounts as more than 70 Labour MPs call for him to quit
stories.summary: More than 70 Labour MPs have urged UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer to set a timetable for his departure after the party's poor performance in local and regional elections. Starmer vowed to fight any leadership challenge, warning the country would not forgive Labour for internal chaos.

stories.title: Four Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza
stories.summary: The Palestinian health ministry reported that four Palestinians were killed by Israeli attacks across Gaza on Monday. The fatalities occurred in southern, central, and northern Gaza, with bodies transported to local hospitals.

stories.title: Lebanon asks US to pressure Israel to halt attacks and operations
stories.summary: Lebanon has requested that the United States pressure Israel to halt ongoing military attacks and operations. Hostilities have continued in southern Lebanon, where Israel maintains a self-declared security zone, despite a ceasefire declared by Trump on April 16.

stories.title: Nigerian military denies reports of civilian deaths after airstrikes in Niger state
stories.summary: Nigeria's Defence Headquarters denied reports of civilian deaths from airstrikes targeting suspected bandits in northern Niger state. The military stated that the strikes were intelligence-led and hit only militant targets.

stories.title: Once, Jews defended themselves to survive. Now this reflects defeat - opinion
stories.summary: An opinion column argues that Israelis and Jewish communities continue to adopt a defensive posture in response to attacks, likening the stance to that of medieval defendants, and calls for a shift in approach.

stories.title: Voloshyn explains how false Russian reports about captured territories affect further assaults
stories.summary: Ukrainian spokesperson Voloshyn reported that Russian commanders in the Orikhiv direction submitted false reports claiming capture of settlements. The inaccurate reporting caused disorganization among Russian artillery and assault units during subsequent operations.

stories.title: Heatstroke suspected among 6 found dead in train carriage at Texas rail depot
stories.summary: Six people, believed to be migrants, were found dead inside a cargo train carriage at a Union Pacific rail depot in Laredo, Texas, near the Mexico border. A South Texas medical examiner suspects heatstroke as the cause of death.

stories.title: Birmingham jury fails to convict pro-Palestine activist accused of supporting Hamas
stories.summary: A Birmingham Crown Court jury failed to convict pro-Palestine activist Majid Freeman, also known as Majid Novsarka, on terrorism-related charges linked to social media posts about Gaza and Palestinian resistance. The court ordered a retrial.

stories.title: Trump calls Iran response ‘stupid proposal’ as conflict risks dragging on
stories.summary: President Donald Trump dismissed Iran's response to a U.S. peace proposal, calling it a 'stupid proposal' one day after labeling it 'unacceptable.' The rejection raises concerns that the conflict may continue without a diplomatic resolution.

stories.title: IDF jails soldiers for photo of cigarette in mouth of Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
stories.summary: The Israeli military sentenced two soldiers to military prison for their roles in desecrating a Virgin Mary statue in the Christian village of Debel in southern Lebanon. The soldier in the photo received three weeks and the photographer two weeks.

stories.title: Israel has tried to drag US into war on Iran for decades, says former Qatari PM
stories.summary: Former Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim al-Thani said Israel has tried for decades to draw the United States into war with Iran. He told Al Jazeera that Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is reshaping the region through violence and that Gulf states cannot rely indefinitely on Washington.

stories.title: London man charged after alleged antisemitic attack on Orthodox Jewish women
stories.summary: London police charged Francis Achile with aggravated assault, assault by beating, and racially aggravated harassment following an alleged antisemitic attack on Orthodox Jewish women in the city.

stories.title: China, U.S. jointly crack down on transnational drug smuggling ring ahead of Trump’s visit
stories.summary: The agencies carried out the operations in Liaoning and Guangdong provinces in China, as well as Florida and Nevada in the U.S., jointly cracking the drug smuggling and trafficking case

stories.title: How Andy Burnham stood up to Starmer over Israel and could now reshape UK foreign policy
stories.summary: Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham has challenged UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's stance on Israel and could seek the Labour leadership. Analysts suggest that if Burnham became prime minister, he would likely shift British foreign policy regarding Israel.

stories.title: Hungary to review Paks nuclear plant expansion, ministerial nominee says
stories.summary: Hungary's nominee for economy and energy affairs minister announced a review of the financing and implementation of the Paks nuclear power plant expansion project. The review comes as a new government outlines its strategy following a landslide election victory.

stories.title: Israeli attacks kill at least four in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli military strikes killed at least four people in southern Lebanon following forced displacement warnings issued to residents of nine towns in southern and eastern Lebanon.

stories.title: 11 killed, several others injured after van plunges into gorge in northwest Pakistan
stories.summary: A wedding journey in northwestern Pakistan turned tragic after a passenger van plunged into a ravine

stories.title: Russians use chemical weapons against Ukrainian soldiers, dropping gas grenade on dugout
stories.summary: Russian forces dropped a gas grenade from a drone onto a dugout occupied by Ukrainian soldiers, constituting use of chemical weapons. The attack occurred as Russian troops attempted to recapture positions lost during a Ukrainian counterattack.

stories.title: Israel closes case against officers accused of killing Palestinian family: Report
stories.summary: Israel closed its investigation into undercover special forces officers accused of killing members of a Palestinian family. Reports indicate the officers involved in the shooting were never questioned during the probe.

stories.title: Taiwan’s parliament passes pared-back supplementary defense budget
stories.summary: Taiwan's parliament approved a supplementary defense budget significantly lower than the NT$1.25 trillion originally proposed by President Lai's administration. The approved funds will be directed toward two separate US arms packages for Taiwan.

stories.title: Cypriot MEP claims Israel buying up Island through real estate, land development
stories.summary: Cypriot MEP Fidias Panayiotou claimed Israel is buying up property and land in Cyprus. Israeli Ambassador to Cyprus Oren Anolik called the remarks deeply concerning.

stories.title: UK sanctions 85 people and entities over ‘pro-Kremlin narratives’
stories.summary: The United Kingdom sanctioned 85 Russia-linked individuals and entities for spreading pro-Kremlin narratives and facilitating the forced deportation and militarization of Ukrainian children. The UK Foreign Office estimates more than 20,000 Ukrainian children have been taken to Russia or Russian-occupied territories.

stories.title: Afghanistan issued demarche after 15 police personnel martyred in Bannu suicide attack
stories.summary: Pakistan summoned Afghanistan's chargé d'affaires and issued a formal demarche following a suicide vehicle-borne IED attack on a police post in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, that killed 15 police personnel. Pakistan attributed the attack to the group it calls Fitna al Khawarij.

stories.title: Israel jails soldiers for desecrating Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
stories.summary: The Israeli military sentenced soldiers involved in desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary during operations in Lebanon. The incident drew global condemnation after photos of the desecration circulated on social media.

stories.title: How Tren de Aragua’s Expansion Sparked Financial Evolution
stories.summary: A money laundering scheme linked to the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua was uncovered in Chile. The discovery illustrates how the gang's transnational expansion across Latin America has driven increasingly sophisticated financial operations.

stories.title: UN expands Nairobi hub as Guterres pushes African representation
stories.summary: The United Nations broke ground on a $340 million expansion of its Nairobi campus in Kenya. The project aims to relocate more UN staff from New York and Geneva to Africa as part of Secretary-General António Guterres's push for greater African representation.

stories.title: Canada expands sanctions against Russia over abduction of Ukrainian children
stories.summary: Canada announced expanded sanctions against Russia over the abduction of Ukrainian children and their subjection to propaganda indoctrination.

stories.title: Two Palestinians killed by Israeli army fire in Gaza
stories.summary: Two Palestinians were killed by Israeli army fire in Gaza on Monday afternoon. Medical sources at Al-Shifa hospital reported one death in the Zeitoun neighbourhood and another in Khan Younis.

stories.title: 'You killed the people of Israel!' Former hostage calls on all Knesset members to resign
stories.summary: Former Israeli hostage Braslavski publicly called on all Knesset members to resign, accusing them of bearing responsibility for failures that cost Israeli lives.

stories.title: Kemi Seba tells South African court he fears for his life if returned to Benin
stories.summary: Anti-Western activist Kemi Seba, wanted in Benin in connection with an alleged coup plot, appeared in a Pretoria court seeking bail. Seba told the court he fears for his life if returned to Benin and was arrested in South Africa for overstaying his visa.

stories.title: India: Modi wants Indians to stop buying gold
stories.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has urged citizens to stop purchasing gold jewellery for one year. The call comes as India faces higher oil import costs due to the Iran war, and Modi hopes reducing gold imports will protect the country's trade balance. The move could significantly impact India's nearly $100 billion gold industry.

stories.title: Europe approves sanctions on West Bank settlers, Hamas leadership
stories.summary: The European Union approved sanctions targeting both Israeli settlers in the West Bank and Hamas leadership. The move followed the inauguration of Hungary's new Prime Minister Peter Magyar, whose predecessor Viktor Orban had frequently vetoed such measures.

stories.title: Israeli soldiers sentenced to military prison for desecrating Christian statues in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: An Israeli soldier was sentenced to 21 days in military prison for desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in southern Lebanon by placing a cigarette in its mouth. The soldier who photographed the act received a 14-day sentence.

stories.title: German media chief declares 'I am a Zionist' at World Jewish Congress in Geneva
stories.summary: Axel Springer CEO Mathias Döpfner declared "I am a Zionist" at the World Jewish Congress in Geneva, delivering a defence of Zionism and urging both Jews and non-Jews to embrace support for Israel.

stories.title: Iran denies proposal sent to US contains ‘excessive demands’
stories.summary: Iran rejected claims that its response to the latest U.S. proposal to end the conflict contained excessive demands. Tehran characterized its counterproposal as reasonable, pushing back against American criticism of the negotiating terms.

stories.title: Here’s why May 14 is a date that matters – opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece discusses the historical significance of May 14, 1948, when Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion proclaimed the establishment of the State of Israel in Tel Aviv.

stories.title: Ukraine ready to open new chapter in relations with Georgia — Sybiha
stories.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha stated that Ukraine is ready to open a new chapter in relations with Georgia following a meeting between the leaders of both countries in Yerevan, Armenia.

stories.title: Israeli troops jailed for desecration of Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
stories.summary: Two Israeli soldiers have been sentenced to weeks in military prison for desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in southern Lebanon. One soldier placed a cigarette in the statue's mouth while the other photographed the act. The IDF said it viewed the incident with great severity amid wider accusations of anti-Christian behavior by Israeli forces in the region.

stories.title: Macron announces €23 billion investment in Africa at Kenya summit
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced €23 billion in investment for Africa at the Africa Forward summit in Nairobi, Kenya. The funding targets energy transition, digital infrastructure, AI, the maritime economy, and agriculture. The two-day summit is aimed at renewing France's engagement with the African continent.

stories.title: Who could challenge Keir Starmer for the UK PM’s job? Meet the candidates
stories.summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces a leadership challenge within his party. Several candidates have emerged as potential contenders to replace him as he promises reform amid political pressure.

stories.title: Plot to coerce girl into carrying out terrorist attack in Islamabad thwarted, CM Bugti says
stories.summary: Balochistan Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti announced that intelligence agencies thwarted a plot to coerce a girl into carrying out a suicide bombing in Islamabad. The girl was arrested before the attack and will be released to her father under supervision rather than face trial.

stories.title: Ukraine and Russia fight on despite US-mediated ceasefire
stories.summary: May 11 - Russia and Ukraine on Monday reported fighting along their long front line despite a U.S.-mediated ceasefire, and each accused the other of launching drone and artillery strikes.

stories.title: Russians attempt to advance in Huliaipole direction — military
stories.summary: Russian troops continued assault operations in the Huliaipole direction, attempting to advance and seize control of several settlements. Ukrainian military officials reported that these attacks have been unsuccessful.

stories.title: Israel not short of missile interceptors, insists chair of Rafael defense firm
stories.summary: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems chairman and former Likud lawmaker Yuval Steinitz insisted Israel is not short of missile interceptors, claiming only several dozen Iranian missiles penetrated air defenses. He did not provide specific figures on current stockpiles or production rates.

stories.title: Lebanon urges US to put pressure on Israel to stop attacks and demolitions
stories.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun urged the United States to pressure Israel into halting military attacks and demolitions in Lebanon. The appeal was made during a meeting with U.S. Ambassador to Lebanon Michel Issa, with Aoun calling on Israel to respect the truce.

stories.title: Israeli elections: Can a Bennett-Lapid alliance oust Netanyahu?
stories.summary: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett and opposition figure Yair Lapid have formed an alliance aimed at unseating Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in upcoming October elections. Analysts remain skeptical the partnership can break Netanyahu's hold on power or shift Israeli policy significantly.

stories.title: Iran War Chokes ‘Major Driver’ of Global Economy
stories.summary: The conflict near the Strait of Hormuz involving Iran is disrupting global energy markets, with diesel prices being hit harder than crude oil. The crisis in the strategically vital waterway threatens a major driver of the global economy.

stories.title: Suspect in attempted Trump assassination at White House press gala pleads not guilty
stories.summary: Cole Allen, 31, pleaded not guilty to charges of attempted assassination of President Trump, assault on a federal officer, and gun crimes stemming from a shooting at the White House Correspondents' Dinner in April.

stories.title: Cellular Intelligence strikes deal with Novo Nordisk to advance Parkinson’s cell therapy
stories.summary: Cellular Intelligence announced a collaboration with pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk to develop a cell therapy treatment for Parkinson's disease.

stories.title: Nigeria: 2027 - INEC Seeks 1.4m Corps Members for Polls
stories.summary: Nigeria's Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) formally requested the deployment of over 1.4 million National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members for the 2027 general elections. INEC stated it cannot conduct elections without NYSC support.

stories.title: PM orders inquiry after PML-N MPA injured in attack in Toba Tek Singh
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered an inquiry after PML-N MPA Col. (ret.) Sardar Ayub Gadhi was injured and four of his aides were killed in a shooting at his outhouse in Toba Tek Singh's Chak 184-GB on Sunday night.

stories.title: EU expected to agree on long-stalled sanctions on Israeli settlers: Kallas
stories.summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said the bloc is expected to agree on long-stalled sanctions targeting Israeli settlers. Officials indicated that seven settlers or settler organizations would be blacklisted.

stories.title: Starmer pledges to bring Britain closer to the EU as he faces calls to step down
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer pledged to bring Britain closer to the European Union while facing calls from within his own Labour Party to resign after poor local election results. Starmer vowed to address major challenges and restore public confidence. More than 60 Labour MPs have demanded he set a timeline for stepping down.

stories.title: Nigeria: Court Orders Trial-Within-Trial As Coup Plot Suspects Deny Written Statements
stories.summary: A court in Nigeria ordered a trial-within-trial after suspects in an alleged coup plot denied authoring written statements attributed to them. The prosecution had sought to enter the extra-judicial statements and accompanying video recordings as evidence.

stories.title: Ukraine and Russia fight on despite US-mediated ceasefire
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine continued fighting along their front line despite a ceasefire agreed for May 9–11, which was part of a U.S.-mediated peace effort led by President Trump.

stories.title: Hantavirus outbreak: Should we worry about the virus spreading?
stories.summary: An American citizen and a French woman evacuated from a cruise ship affected by a hantavirus outbreak have tested positive for the virus. At least six cases have been confirmed, two are suspected, and three passengers have died. Repatriation operations from the ship continued on Monday as health authorities monitored the spread of the rare virus.

stories.title: EU expands sanctions against Russia over deportation of Ukrainian children
stories.summary: The European Union imposed sanctions on 23 individuals and entities on May 11 for involvement in the illegal forced deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia.

stories.title: Nigeria 2027: Atiku, Obi and Kwankwaso’s split widens Tinubu’s reelection path
stories.summary: Nigeria's main opposition figures — Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, and Rabiu Kwankwaso — are failing to unite against President Bola Tinubu ahead of the 2027 elections. Rival ambitions, defections, and mistrust threaten to split anti-APC votes, potentially widening Tinubu's path to reelection.

stories.title: Canada eyes Turkey as a fellow mid-power ally in weapons development
stories.summary: A senior Canadian official indicated that Canada is looking to Turkey as a potential mid-power partner in weapons development. Ottawa is studying Turkey's approach to building a domestic defense industrial ecosystem for producing vital military equipment, seeking lessons applicable to Canada's own defense sector.

stories.title: A French passenger from hantavirus-hit ship has tested positive for the virus
stories.summary: A French passenger evacuated from the hantavirus-affected MV Hondius cruise ship has tested positive for the virus. French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu scheduled a meeting on the hantavirus crisis for May 11.

stories.title: Did US pressure before Xi-Trump summit force KMT hand on Taiwan’s defence budget?
stories.summary: Analysts suggest U.S. pressure likely pushed Taiwan's opposition KMT party to support an expanded special defence budget ahead of a summit between Presidents Trump and Xi Jinping. Taipei is concerned about potential U.S. concessions to Beijing, which considers Taiwan a core interest.

stories.title: Israeli killings in Lebanon rise: Is even the pretence of a ceasefire over?
stories.summary: Israel and Hezbollah have escalated attacks against each other in Lebanon despite an official ceasefire being in place. The rising number of Israeli killings in Lebanon has raised questions about whether the truce remains viable.

stories.title: Africa Forward Summit in Kenya: France offers ‘third way’ in Africa’s AI race
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron co-hosted the Africa Forward summit in Nairobi with Kenyan President William Ruto, focusing on trade, investment, and technology. Kenya aims to expand its capacity to meet Africa's growing artificial intelligence needs. France used the summit to position itself as offering a third option between US and Chinese tech dominance.

stories.title: Iranian and Saudi foreign ministers hold phone call
stories.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan held a phone call on Monday to discuss the latest diplomatic developments between Iran and the United States, with Pakistan serving as mediator.

stories.title: Changing tax rules for investors won’t shrink housing supply or raise rents. Just look at Victoria
stories.summary: The Australian federal government is preparing budget reforms to reframe housing as shelter rather than a financial asset, adjusting tax rules for property investors. Critics warn the changes could increase rents and reduce housing supply, but the article points to Victoria's experience as evidence against those claims.

stories.title: Ramaphosa says ‘no place’ for xenophobia in South Africa after attacks
stories.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa condemned xenophobic violence, saying there is no place for it in the country. His remarks followed expressions of concern from Nigeria and Ghana over the safety of their citizens in South Africa.

stories.title: UK expands sanctions on Russia over deportation of Ukrainian children, information warfare
stories.summary: The United Kingdom imposed new sanctions on 85 individuals and entities involved in the illegal deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia. The measures also targeted employees of the Russian IT company Social Design Agency, which produces Kremlin propaganda.

stories.title: Hegseth says Pentagon will review Mark Kelly’s US weapons stockpile remarks
stories.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the Pentagon will review remarks by Senator Mark Kelly regarding depleted American weapons stockpiles, accusing Kelly of disclosing classified information. Kelly countered that his statements were based on Hegseth's own public, sworn testimony. The weapons in question include Tomahawk cruise missiles, ATACMS, SM-3 interceptors, and Patriot missiles.

stories.title: Ukraine reports Russian attacks and battlefield clashes despite ceasefire
stories.summary: Ukraine and Russia agreed to a U.S.-brokered ceasefire from May 9 to May 11, but Ukraine reported continued Russian attacks and battlefield clashes during the truce period. The ceasefire was part of President Donald Trump's push to end the war that began with Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

stories.title: Somali security forces open fire on protesters in Mogadishu, killing one
stories.summary: Somali security forces opened fire on an opposition-led protest in Mogadishu on Sunday, killing one person and injuring another. The incident deepened political tensions as President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term nears expiration.

stories.title: Religion steers Bengal politics in Bangladesh, India — again
stories.summary: Religion is playing an increasingly prominent role in politics across Bengal, spanning both Bangladesh and India's West Bengal. Islamist movements are gaining strength in Bangladesh, while the Hindu nationalist BJP has taken power in India's West Bengal state.

stories.title: Fedorov, Pistorius agree to launch Brave Germany program to boost defense innovation
stories.summary: Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius signed a letter of intent in Kyiv to launch Brave Germany, a joint program aimed at developing defense technologies and supporting innovative defense startups.

stories.title: Evacuation of passengers from virus-hit cruise ship to be completed on Monday
stories.summary: Spain's health minister announced that the evacuation of passengers from the Dutch-flagged cruise ship affected by a deadly hantavirus outbreak would be completed on Monday. Flights from Australia and the Netherlands were arranged to transport the remaining passengers.

stories.title: Despite protests, Israeli Biennale pavilion opens, includes Jewish mystical symbols
stories.summary: Israel's pavilion at the art Biennale opened despite protests, featuring an installation called 'Rose of Nothingness' by artist Belu-Simion Fainaru. The work incorporates Jewish mystical symbols including mezuzah scrolls and water-dripping tubes.

stories.title: Aramco: Current energy supply shock 'largest ever experienced'
stories.summary: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser described the current energy supply disruption as the largest ever experienced, warning that even if the Strait of Hormuz reopened immediately, restoring market balance would take months. He estimated markets could lose around 100 million barrels of oil per week while the strait remains disrupted.

stories.title: South Africa's winegrowers working to stay one step ahead of warming planet
stories.summary: Winegrowers in South Africa's Western Cape province are adapting their practices to address the effects of climate change. Producers are working to stay ahead of rising temperatures that threaten the region's wine industry.

stories.title: White House press gala shooting suspect pleads not guilty to attempted assassination of Donald Trump
stories.summary: Cole Allen, a California man accused of attempting to assassinate US President Donald Trump at last month's White House Correspondents' Dinner, pleaded not guilty to all charges on Monday. Prosecutors allege Allen fired a shotgun at a Secret Service agent and stormed a security checkpoint in the foiled April attack.

stories.title: KP CM Afridi decries decisions made behind closed doors during visit to Bannu
stories.summary: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi visited Bannu following a suicide attack on the Fateh Khel police post that killed 15 officers and injured three. He met families of the martyred personnel and criticized decisions made behind closed doors that he said went against peace in the province.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez defends Essequibo claim at The Hague under temporary EU sanctions waiver
stories.summary: Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodríguez traveled to the Netherlands to defend her country's territorial claim to the Essequibo region before the International Court of Justice. The trip was authorized under a specific EU sanctions waiver and marks her first major international journey since assuming office after President Nicolás Maduro's capture by U.S. forces in January.

stories.title: Ukraine and Russia fight on despite US-mediated ceasefire
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine continued fighting along their front line on Monday despite a US-mediated ceasefire agreed upon from May 9 to May 11. Both sides accused each other of launching drone and artillery strikes in violation of the truce. The ceasefire was part of a US-led peace push under President Donald Trump.

stories.title: Hantavirus: France enforces strict measures after citizen tests positive
stories.summary: A French citizen repatriated from a cruise ship docked in Tenerife, Spain, has tested positive for hantavirus, with her condition worsening overnight. She was among five French nationals evacuated from the vessel on Sunday. French authorities have enforced strict health measures in response to the case.

stories.title: Hantavirus: French PM Lecornu holds talks with medical advisers, ministers
stories.summary: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu convened a meeting with medical advisers and ministers to address the hantavirus crisis after a repatriated French passenger tested positive and her condition deteriorated. The patient had been aboard a cruise ship hit by the hantavirus outbreak. French authorities are coordinating their response from Paris.

stories.title: Africa: 'Hey, Hey, Hey!' - Macron Rebukes Noisy Audience at Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron interrupted proceedings at a youth forum during the Africa Forward Summit at the University of Nairobi. Macron rebuked sections of the audience for disrupting a speaker during the discussions.

stories.title: Somalia: Somali Opposition Condemns Government Over Blocked Protest in Mogadishu
stories.summary: Somalia's opposition coalition, the Somali Salvation Forum, condemned the government for blocking a planned peaceful protest in Mogadishu. The statement followed reports of security forces dispersing demonstrators, which resulted in at least one death.

stories.title: Iran war effect: Why is Modi asking Indians to avoid foreign trips, gold?
stories.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to work from home and avoid foreign travel and gold purchases amid a global energy crisis linked to the Iran war. The guidance aims to reduce India's exposure to economic disruptions caused by the conflict.

stories.title: Russia sacrificed fuel capacity on its Kh-101 to pack heavier warhead and added incendiary steel balls with zirconium
stories.summary: Russia modified its Kh-101 cruise missile by reducing fuel capacity and range to accommodate a heavier warhead, reportedly adding incendiary steel balls containing zirconium. The original variant carried a 500 kg warhead with a 2,500 km range.

stories.title: Is the US empire in the middle of a long decline?
stories.summary: Economist Richard Wolff argued that the Iran war has placed the United States in a position where it cannot control events but also cannot disengage. His comments fuel broader debate about whether the U.S. is experiencing a prolonged imperial decline.

stories.title: Lebanon Latest
stories.summary: Lebanon experienced multiple days of deadly attacks, with ongoing hostilities causing casualties across the country.

stories.title: Six people found dead inside train car at rail yard near Texas-Mexico border
stories.summary: Six people were found dead inside a boxcar at a Union Pacific rail yard in Laredo, Texas, near the Mexican border. A railroad employee discovered the bodies while inspecting a stopped train before it continued northward. Authorities are investigating the circumstances of the deaths.

stories.title: Unearthing a Colombian Politician’s Connections to Neo-Nazi Active Club Group
stories.summary: A joint investigation by Bellingcat and Colombian outlet Cerosetenta has uncovered links between a Colombian political candidate and a neo-Nazi Active Club group. A February 26 video showed men painting over graffiti in the Restrepo neighborhood of Bogotá, replacing it with the candidate's logo and associated imagery.

stories.title: Lebanese civil defence worker captures moment of Israeli strike
stories.summary: A Lebanese civil defence worker filmed the moment an Israeli airstrike struck an active rescue operation in southern Lebanon. The footage documented the strike hitting the area where first responders were working.

stories.title: Israel-caused death toll in Lebanon rises to 2869
stories.summary: Lebanon's Ministry of Public Health reported that Israeli military operations have killed 2,869 people and injured 8,730 in Lebanon since March 2. Israeli airstrikes continue to hit southern Lebanese towns despite a US-brokered ceasefire.

stories.title: Hungary says it will no longer use veto as tool of pressure on EU
stories.summary: Hungary's new Foreign Minister Anita Orban announced that Hungary will no longer use its EU veto as a tool of political pressure. She pledged to rebuild trust with EU and NATO partners.

stories.title: Philippine lawmaker holes up in Senate as ICC confirms drug war warrant
stories.summary: A sitting Philippine senator wanted by the International Criminal Court for his role in former president Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war took refuge inside the Senate on Monday to avoid arrest by governmen

stories.title: Warning that increase in shipping around South Africa to avoid Middle East could harm whales
stories.summary: Increased shipping traffic around South Africa's Cape of Good Hope, driven by vessels rerouting since 2023 to avoid Middle East conflicts, has raised concerns about potential harm to whale populations in the region.

stories.title: Epic Fury has Navy rethinking carrier deployment tempo
stories.summary: The USS Gerald R. Ford's record-breaking deployment has prompted the U.S. Navy to reassess how it structures carrier deployment schedules and the balance between time at sea and time at home port.

stories.title: Iran says made 'legitimate' demands in peace proposal rejected by Trump as 'totally unacceptable'
stories.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said Tehran's peace proposal included demands to end the regional war, lift the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports, and release frozen assets abroad. U.S. President Donald Trump had rejected the response as "totally unacceptable."

stories.title: EU ministers agree on sanctions for Israeli settlers
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers agreed to impose new sanctions targeting violent Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar rejected the measures, calling them arbitrary and politically motivated.

stories.title: Israel pushes for hangings and ‘show trials’ for ‘October 7 detainees’
stories.summary: Israel is advancing legislation that would allow October 7 detainees to be tried in military courts, with some officials pushing for public trials and the death penalty. Human rights advocates have raised concerns about the fairness of such proceedings.

stories.title: Trump says Iran ‘will fold,’ weighs restarting operation to escort ships through Hormuz
stories.summary: President Trump said Iran 'will fold' and indicated he is considering restarting a military operation to escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu convened a security cabinet meeting, while Turkey's foreign minister planned talks with Qatar's counterpart on the strait crisis.

stories.title: Four Ukrainians remain on MV Hondius cruise ship after hantavirus outbreak killed three
stories.summary: Four Ukrainian crew members remain aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship following a hantavirus outbreak that killed three people. A fifth Ukrainian crew member is being evacuated by special flight to the Netherlands.

stories.title: Second Qatari tanker crossing Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: A second Qatari LNG tanker, the Mihzem, transited the Strait of Hormuz bound for Pakistan, following a successful passage by another vessel over the weekend. Iran approved the shipments under an arrangement facilitated by Pakistan, which is mediating between Tehran and Washington.

stories.title: Trump heads to China this week to meet Xi as Iran war and trade disputes loom over summit – US politics live

stories.title: Five injured, including teen, in Russian shelling of Kherson
stories.summary: Five people, including a teenager, were injured in the city of Kherson as a result of Russian shelling.

stories.title: Dozens of Nigerian fishermen feared dead after Chad air strikes on Boko Haram
stories.summary: Approximately 40 Nigerian fishermen are feared dead following Chadian air strikes targeting Boko Haram positions. Victims were killed either directly by the strikes or by drowning while attempting to flee.

stories.title: Family of Florida university shooting victim sues over suspect’s ChatGPT use
stories.summary: Federal lawsuit against OpenAI says alleged gunman had extensive conversations with chatbot over monthsThe family of one of two people killed in an April 2025 shooting at Florida State University (FSU

stories.title: Boycotts, beats and bling: Eurovision’s 70th edition kicks off in Vienna
stories.summary: The 70th Eurovision Song Contest began in Vienna with 35 competing nations, amid heightened security, expected protests, and backstage tensions largely centered on Israel's participation.

stories.title: Chicago teen who pushed for parents’ release from ICE custody dies of cancer
stories.summary: Kevin González, 18-year-old who had terminal colon cancer, died shortly after reuniting with his parents in MexicoA Chicago-born teen who advocated for his parents’ release from US immigration authori

stories.title: IAF helicopter malfunctions during Lebanon rescue, IDF says not hit by enemy fire
stories.summary: An Israeli Air Force helicopter malfunctioned during a rescue operation in Lebanon, though the IDF stated it was not hit by enemy fire. A second helicopter was dispatched to evacuate three soldiers.

stories.summary:
