Cole Allen, 31, did not speak in court

stories.title: Who Wants Hezbollah to Stay Armed?
stories.summary: An analysis examines public support in Lebanon for Hezbollah retaining its weapons. The findings suggest that grievances with the Lebanese state, rather than sectarian loyalty, are the primary factor driving popular backing for the armed group to keep its arsenal.

stories.title: China deepens footprint at AI conference despite NeurIPS dispute, US tensions
stories.summary: Chinese technology companies and researchers turned out in force at a leading global artificial intelligence conference, despite mounting questions over whether they might avoid the event as a consequ

stories.title: Trump urged to raise cases of detained Americans when he meets Xi in Beijing
stories.summary: A US congressional commission is pressing President Donald Trump to confront his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping over detained Americans when the leaders meet this week, warning that silence would leav

stories.title: Under-threat UK PM Starmer vows to prove 'doubters' wrong
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer vowed to prove critics wrong amid mounting criticism over his stance on the Gaza conflict, the Peter Mandelson scandal, and the domestic cost-of-living crisis.

stories.title: Seven people barred from coming to UK for far-right rally
stories.summary: Keir Starmer says ‘agitators’ will be blocked from attending Tommy Robinson’s Unite the Kingdom eventUK politics live – latest updatesSeven people hoping to attend a far-right rally in central London

stories.title: Macron denies plans to send French warships to Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron, speaking during a visit to Kenya, denied any plans to deploy French warships into the Strait of Hormuz, stating France had never envisaged such a move.

stories.title: France's Macron announces more than €1 billion of investment deals in Kenya
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced more than €1 billion in investment deals during a visit to Kenya, where he co-hosted the Africa-Forward summit with his Kenyan counterpart.

stories.title: Spain, Ireland, Slovenia will not broadcast Eurovision over Israel's participation
stories.summary: Spain, Ireland, and Slovenia announced they will not broadcast the Eurovision Song Contest grand final on Saturday in protest over Israel's participation. Slovenia's RTV will air the series "Voices of Palestine" instead, while Ireland will broadcast a Eurovision-themed episode of the sitcom "Father Ted." The boycott expands on the three countries' earlier refusal to participate.

stories.title: Arab-Israeli activist Yoseph Haddad weighs new party bid with ex-Jerusalem deputy mayor - exclusive
stories.summary: Arab-Israeli activist Yoseph Haddad is exploring launching a new political party alongside a former Jerusalem deputy mayor, aiming to convert his social media following into political influence.

stories.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man in Qalandiya, West Bank
stories.summary: Israeli forces shot and killed 30-year-old Rafiq Muhammad al-Hashlamoun during a raid on Qalandiya refugee camp in the occupied West Bank. Troops reportedly stormed a vocational training centre and fired live ammunition, striking al-Hashlamoun in the head.

stories.title: China’s Malacca Dilemma, After Hormuz
stories.summary: Western-dominated insurance premiums can choke off Beijing’s oil supplies more effectively than warships can.

stories.title: Michael Pennington, Shakespeare and Star Wars actor, dies aged 82
stories.summary: ‘Brilliant, wise’ co-founder of English Shakespeare Company celebrated for roles including Macbeth and MercutioThe actor Michael Pennington, known for his Shakespearean work and his role in the origin

stories.title: At least six people found dead in boxcar in Laredo, Texas, police say
stories.summary: At least six people were found dead in a boxcar in Laredo, Texas, near the U.S.-Mexico border. Police noted that past incidents of multiple deaths in trains and tractor trailers in the border region have involved migrants.

stories.title: EU approves new sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
stories.summary: The European Union on Monday approved new sanctions on Israeli settlers "guilty of supporting the extremist and violent colonisation of the West Bank", French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said on

stories.title: Gulf turns to Turkey for air defence systems amid Iran threats
stories.summary: Gulf states are increasingly turning to Turkey to procure air defence systems amid ongoing threats from Iran and backlogs from traditional US suppliers. Turkish military products, including drones and armoured vehicles, are drawing regional interest.

stories.title: South Africa: Pick 'n Pay Workers Ready to Strike Over Pay Cuts
stories.summary: South Africa's SACCAWU union says Pick n Pay supermarket chain plans to cut night transport, subsidized meals, and Sunday pay for full-time workers. The union is preparing for a strike, while Pick n Pay denies any plans to fire employees.

stories.title: Asian shares mixed, oil jumps 4% after Donald Trump rejects Iran's response to ceasefire proposal
stories.summary: Oil prices surged roughly 4% after U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's response to a ceasefire proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable." Asian stock markets showed mixed results following the development.

stories.title: Umerov discusses possible leader-level meeting formats in US to end war – Zelensky
stories.summary: Ukraine's National Security and Defense Council Secretary Rustem Umerov discussed possible formats for leadership-level meetings in the United States aimed at ending the war, according to President Zelensky.

stories.title: South Africa: Attackers Burn Activist Ngizwe Mchunu's Home in Mbumbulu
stories.summary: Unknown attackers set fire to the home of South African activist Ngizwe Mchunu in Mbumbulu, south of Durban, destroying the main house and traditional rondavels. Two weeks earlier, attackers also vandalized the home of activist Felemntwnini Gumede.

stories.title: U.K. Sanctions Russian ‘Disinformation’ Outfit Over Plot to Sway Armenian Elections
stories.summary: The United Kingdom sanctioned 49 employees of Russia's Social Design Agency, a group already under Western sanctions, over an alleged plot to interfere in Armenian elections through disinformation operations.

stories.title: Remains of missing soldier found off the coast of Morocco
stories.summary: The U.S. Army announced that the remains of a soldier reported missing in southern Morocco the previous week have been recovered off the Moroccan coast.

stories.title: Three months absent from your shop in occupied Luhansk? Russia declares it “ownerless” and takes it
stories.summary: Russian occupation authorities in Luhansk are targeting approximately 150 commercial properties for seizure as "ownerless," including shops left vacant for three months or those with a single unpaid utility bill.

stories.title: Civil aviation head says US refuelers at Ben Gurion are crowding out civilian planes
stories.summary: Israel's civil aviation authority head Shmuel Zakai warned that US military refueling aircraft stationed at Ben Gurion Airport are occupying parking space needed by civilian planes, potentially raising fares and reducing flight availability.

stories.title: For settlers, reestablishing Sa-Nur in the West Bank is a dream realized
stories.summary: Israeli settlers have reestablished the Sa-Nur settlement in the occupied West Bank, which was evacuated under a 2025 disengagement plan. Residents described the move as a historic correction.

stories.title: US, French nationals from hantavirus ship test positive
stories.summary: An American national and a French woman evacuated from the hantavirus-affected cruise ship MV Hondius tested positive for the virus. The French passenger fell ill on a repatriation flight and was placed in isolation in Paris, while the complex operation to repatriate remaining passengers continued.

stories.title: Nigeria's solar boom faces cost and policy barriers
stories.summary: Nigeria's solar energy imports are rising as consumers seek alternatives to an unreliable power grid and high fuel costs. However, adoption is hindered by steep upfront prices, limited financing options, and policy uncertainty.

stories.title: Ukraine resumes fuel imports from Hungary and Slovakia – expert
stories.summary: Ukraine resumed fuel imports from Hungary and Slovakia, though experts said the resumption would not affect domestic fuel prices.

stories.title: What is Trump's 'Project Freedom Plus' plan against Iran?
stories.summary: President Trump referenced a plan called "Project Freedom Plus" aimed at Iran, describing it as an escalation beyond the original "Project Freedom" framework should diplomatic progress stall.

stories.title: War initiative has shifted in Ukraine's favor for first time in nearly three years – The Economist
stories.summary: The Economist reported that the initiative in the Russia-Ukraine war has shifted in Ukraine's favor for the first time in nearly three years of full-scale conflict.

stories.title: Gazans increasingly support a two-state solution, majority have unfavorable opinion of Iran - poll
stories.summary: A recent poll shows growing support among Palestinians in Gaza for a two-state solution, while a majority hold unfavorable views of Iran. Opposition to normalization with Israel remains strong across Palestinian territories.

stories.title: IT exports expected to reach $4bn during current fiscal year, PM told
stories.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif was briefed that the country's IT exports are expected to reach $4.5–4.6 billion in the current fiscal year. Domestic internet connections reportedly grew from 1.9 million in 2024 to 5.1 million in 2026.

stories.title: Will Starmer’s election woes force a shake-up in the UK’s ties with China?
stories.summary: The ruling Labour Party’s dire results in local and regional elections in the UK late last week had damaged Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s authority and could lead to policy shifts, Chinese experts sai

stories.title: Iran war ceasefire grows increasingly shaky after Trump rejects Tehran's latest proposal
stories.summary: The ceasefire between the United States and Iran is growing increasingly fragile as both sides rejected each other's latest diplomatic proposals.

stories.title: 'I will make order': Macorn calls for silence at Africa summit
stories.summary: The French president is currently in #Nairobi for the Africa Forward summit, a gathering meant to showcase France’s new policy for the continent. It is the first time the summit is held in an English-

stories.title: Hantavirus ship evacuation nears completion as 94 flown home
stories.summary: A complex day-long operation to repatriate  occupants of a cruise ship struck by a deadly hantavirus outbreak neared completion late Sunday after 94 people of various nationalities were flown home fro

stories.title: ‘Unacceptable’: What’s Iran’s peace proposal that Trump has rejected?
stories.summary: Tehran sent a counterproposal through Pakistani mediators in response to an earlier US offer to end the conflict, but the Trump administration rejected it as unacceptable.

stories.title: Iran-US ceasefire grows shaky after Trump rejects Tehran's latest proposal
stories.summary: Iran and the United States were at an impasse again Monday over how to end their war while their ceasefire grew increasingly shaky, with the two sides exchanging fire in recent days, ships and Gulf st

stories.summary: Embattled British Prime Minister Keir Starmer came out fighting Monday, vowing to prove his "doubters" wrong as he sought to quell a growing threat to his leadership following disastrous election resu

stories.title: Putin picked Schröder for the EU. Kallas: he’d sit on both sides of the table
stories.summary: Russia proposed former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder as a negotiator for EU talks. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas rejected the proposal, noting Schröder would represent both sides. Berlin had already declined the suggestion.

stories.title: Ukraine ready to send expert team to Finland after drone incidents – Sybiha
stories.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha offered to send a team of experts to Finland to share experience on airspace protection following recent drone incidents. The proposal came during a meeting with Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen in Brussels.

stories.title: What will happen to Iran's nuclear material?
stories.summary: Iran is believed to possess over 440 kilograms of enriched uranium with potential for conversion to weapons-grade material. Despite U.S. President Trump's pledge to secure Iran's nuclear material, Tehran has kept it beyond American reach.

stories.title: Philippine lawmakers impeach Vice President Sara Duterte
stories.summary: The Philippine House of Representatives impeached Vice President Sara Duterte for the second time in two years, advancing formal charges against her.

stories.title: Eyeing migrant returns, EU pushes to revive Syria ties
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers are set to meet in Brussels with Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani to launch a formal political dialogue. The engagement comes 18 months after the ouster of Bashar al-Assad, with the bloc seeking to facilitate the return of migrants to Syria.

stories.title: US-China negotiations seek a quick Seoul search for deals ahead of Trump’s visit
stories.summary: The next round of US-China trade talks appears to be a rushed precursor intended to set the stage for President Donald Trump’s state visit to Beijing, according to analysts who expect only modest deli

stories.title: EU’s 21st Russia sanctions package will target the shadow fleet, banks, and firms selling stolen Ukrainian grain—Politico
stories.summary: The European Union's 21st sanctions package against Russia is expected in late June or early July, targeting shadow fleet vessels, banks, and firms involved in selling stolen Ukrainian grain. Hungary's change of government has unblocked previously vetoed measures, including sanctions on Patriarch Kirill.

stories.title: No hotpot: Hong Kong dog-friendly restaurants face menu and layout limits
stories.summary: Hong Kong restaurants applying for a licence that allows dogs will have to remove any hotpot from their menus and change their layout to comply with new regulations aimed at ensuring food and pet safe

stories.title: Mali's Mamadou Sangaré named top African player in French football league
stories.summary: RC Lens midfielder Mamadou Sangaré of Mali was voted the top African player in France's Ligue 1, becoming the first Malian to win the Marc-Vivien Foé prize awarded by RFI and France 24.

stories.title: Russia approves historical education concept calling for ‘Russia-centrism’ and use of war veterans in schools
stories.summary: Russia's Education Ministry approved a new historical education concept promoting "Russia-centrism" and incorporating war veterans into school instruction.

stories.title: Ukraine's Khartiia units improve tactical position on Vovchansk axis
stories.summary: Units of Ukraine's 2nd Corps of the National Guard, known as Khartiia, conducted strike-and-search operations in the Vovchansk sector, clearing Russian positions and improving the tactical situation for Ukrainian forces.

stories.title: All technologies shown at SAHA 2026 already deployed on frontlines – RAROG
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense company RAROG presented armor protection, strike drones, and integrated frontline solutions at the SAHA 2026 defense exhibition in Istanbul. The company stated that all showcased technologies are already deployed in active combat conditions in Ukraine.

stories.title: Iran Does Not Have a Right to Enrich Uranium
stories.summary: The article argues that the Trump administration should demand that Iran agree to zero uranium enrichment permanently as a condition of any future nuclear deal with Tehran.

stories.title: Huawei’s secretive chip lab featured on prime-time TV ahead of Trump’s trip to China

stories.title: Latin America is reassessing the benefits of warm ties with Beijing
stories.summary: Beijing’s position in Latin America is far from collapsing, looking at the number of countries in the region that have switched diplomatic ties to it from Taipei. But in parts of the continent, govern

stories.title: Asia braces for second wave of energy shocks from Iran war
stories.summary: Asian governments are bracing for a second wave of energy shocks stemming from the Iran conflict. Officials face difficult trade-offs between saving power, prioritizing household gas supplies over fertilizer production, and drawing down energy stockpiles for temporary relief.

stories.summary: Kaspersky Lab co-founder Natalya Kasperskaya met with officers of the FSB's Second Service in late April to discuss VPN bans and internet blocking in Russia. Sources told The Bell that Kasperskaya was frustrated by the constantly changing rules and the FSB unit's limited understanding of how networks function.

stories.title: Hezbollah drone kills Israeli soldier in south Lebanon
stories.summary: Hezbollah launched a drone strike in southern Lebanon that killed an Israeli soldier. Recent analyses have pointed to structural and operational failures within Israeli security and military institutions.

stories.title: Payout for worker who said Sara Netanyahu threw tomatoes and olives at her – reports
stories.summary: A household employee reportedly received a financial payout after alleging that Sara Netanyahu threw tomatoes and olives at her when a salad did not meet her expectations. Prime Minister Netanyahu was reportedly present during the incident.

stories.title: War on Iran: Senior royal says Saudi Arabia avoided Israeli plan to 'plunge region into ruin'
stories.summary: Saudi Prince Turki al-Faisal wrote that Saudi Arabia avoided what he described as an Israeli plan to draw the kingdom into a ruinous regional conflict. He argued that had Israel succeeded, thousands of Saudi lives would have been lost in a war with no Saudi stake.

stories.title: ‘It’s organised intimidation’: New wave of anti-migrant violence sweeps South Africa
stories.summary: Videos posted online document the new wave of deadly anti-migrant violence that has been sweeping South Africa since late March 2026, killing at least seven people. Organised anti-migrant movements ar

stories.title: Donald Trump eyes deal in Beijing as China gauges U.S. ‘decline’
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump is scheduled to visit China from May 13 to 15, with trade, technology, and Taiwan on the agenda. The visit comes amid the US-Israel-Iran conflict and a global energy crisis.

stories.title: Raytheon awarded SeaRAM contract for Australian frigates
stories.summary: Raytheon has been awarded a contract to supply SeaRAM close-in weapon systems for three Australian frigates that are slated to be built in Japan.

stories.title: Iran insists latest proposal is 'generous' despite Trump’s rejection
stories.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei reiterated that Tehran's latest proposal to end the war with the US is "generous" and "legitimate," despite President Trump's rejection of the terms.

stories.title: Police say 25 sacrificial goats worth Rs1.9m stolen from Karachi's Gulistan-i-Jauhar
stories.summary: Police in Karachi reported that 25 sacrificial goats worth 1.9 million rupees were stolen from an empty plot in Gulistan-i-Jauhar's Block 8. Three to four suspects arrived in a Suzuki van on Saturday night and took all the animals despite a watchman being present.

stories.title: Israeli settlers force Palestinian family to rebury dead father
stories.summary: Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank forced a Palestinian man named Mohammad to exhume his recently buried father's body and rebury it in a neighbouring village.

stories.title: Germany seeks to expand joint deep strike weapons production with Ukraine – Pistorius
stories.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius announced Germany's intention to expand joint production of deep strike weapons with Ukraine, signaling deeper defense-industrial cooperation between the two countries.

stories.title: Portugal just hit highest defense-industry growth since 1986. Its defense minister links boom to Russia’s war
stories.summary: Portugal has experienced its highest defense-industry growth since 1986, with nearly 100 new defense companies established in 16 months. Portugal's defense minister attributed the boom to Russia's war in Ukraine.

stories.title: Russian director Alexander Sokurov withdraws from Venice Biennale after activists’ open letter calls his participation a staged performance
stories.summary: Russian director Alexander Sokurov withdrew from the Venice Biennale's "Dissent and Peace" conference after Russian and Italian cultural figures published an open letter opposing his participation. The biennale cited "sudden unavailability" as the reason for his absence.

stories.title: Border Police kill terrorist who opened fire on troops in Kalandiya
stories.summary: Israeli border police killed a gunman who opened fire on forces at the Kalandiya checkpoint in the occupied West Bank. The attacker emerged from a vehicle and shot at officers, who returned fire. No officers were injured.

stories.title: Israel kills three, including police officers, in latest Gaza truce violation
stories.summary: Israeli forces killed three Palestinians in Gaza over 24 hours, including two police officers, in violations of an October ceasefire deal. An Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis's al-Amal neighbourhood targeted a vehicle carrying the local police investigations director and a sergeant.

stories.title: From David to Goliath: Analyzing media coverage of Israel
stories.summary: Professor Eli Avraham's book "From David to Goliath" examines international media coverage of Israel, analyzing patterns of bias and their effects on global public opinion.

stories.title: Four killed in Israeli attack in southern Lebanon, including elderly woman and grandson
stories.summary: Israeli airstrikes killed at least four people in southern Lebanon's Nabatieh municipality, including 78-year-old Najia Hassan Rammal and her 11-year-old grandson in the village of Abba. Two brothers were killed in a separate strike on the village of Jarjouaa.

stories.title: New EU sanctions against Russia expected by early summer – Politico
stories.summary: The European Union is expected to adopt a new sanctions package against Russia over its war in Ukraine by late June or early July, according to a report by Politico.

stories.title: Congolese singer Gloria Bash's fight for peace: 'Music is a weapon' [Interview]
stories.summary: Congolese singer Gloria Bash released her EP "Zoshi," celebrating her home city of Goma and advocating for peace in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Iran says its demands were seeking peace, while the US’s are ‘unreasonable’
stories.summary: Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei stated that Iran's latest negotiating response was dismissed by the United States, characterizing Iran's demands as peace-oriented while calling U.S. conditions unreasonable.

stories.title: Netanyahu trial hearing opens behind closed doors amid Iran proposal tensions
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial continued behind closed doors with cross-examination by prosecutors, who confronted him with alleged inconsistencies in his testimony. The hearing coincided with tensions over Iran peace proposals.

stories.title: EU rejects Putin call for Gerhard Schröder role in Ukraine peace talks
stories.summary: Top EU diplomat Kaja Kallas says Kremlin-friendly former German chancellor cannot be considered impartialEurope live – latest updatesThe EU on Monday dismissed Vladimir Putin’s suggestion that the Kre

stories.title: EU agrees to restore full trade ties with Syria
stories.summary: The European Council agreed to restore full trade relations with Syria, framing the decision as a signal of the EU's commitment to re-engage with Damascus.

stories.title: Chinese smart cars set to control 20% of western European market by 2028: JPMorgan
stories.summary: The pace of electrification on western Europe’s roads is likely to fire up sales of Chinese-developed smart cars, where they could command a 20 per cent share of the regional market in 2028 at the exp

stories.title: Watch: Preparing to exchange 1000 prisoners of war with Russia: Volodymyr Zelenskyy
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced preparations for an exchange of 1,000 prisoners of war with Russia.

stories.title: Pakistan PM announces to celebrate May 10 as ‘Marka-e-Haq Day’ every year
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced that May 10 will be celebrated annually as 'Marka-e-Haq Day,' marking the first anniversary of what he described as a historic military response by Pakistan's armed forces.

stories.title: Woman shot dead, three injured in Ramle; police arrest husband
stories.summary: A woman was shot dead and three others were injured in Ramle, Israel, in what police are investigating as a suspected femicide. The victim's husband was arrested. Hours later, a teenager was shot and injured in nearby Lod.

stories.title: Malawi: NGOs Under Fire As Teenage Pregnancies Remain At 32 Percent Despite Decades of Interventions
stories.summary: University of Malawi researchers found that teenage pregnancy rates remain at 32 percent despite decades of government and NGO interventions, donor-funded programs, and awareness campaigns.

stories.title: CinC Syrskyi inspects Khartia Corps near Kupiansk, orders focus on drones, logistics, fortifications
stories.summary: Ukrainian Commander-in-Chief General Oleksandr Syrskyi visited the 2nd Corps of the National Guard's Khartia brigade near Kupiansk. He discussed the operational situation with commanders and ordered a focus on drones, logistics, and fortification efforts.

stories.title: Sudan drone strikes killed at least 880 civilians between January and April: UN
stories.summary: The United Nations reported that drone strikes in Sudan killed at least 880 civilians between January and April, warning that the intensification signals a potentially deadlier phase of the ongoing war.

stories.title: Gaza doc dropped by BBC wins BAFTA, creators blast 'censorship'
stories.summary: A documentary about Gaza that was dropped by the BBC won a BAFTA award. Its creators condemned the BBC's decision as censorship. The film's broadcasting rights were subsequently acquired by Channel 4 and Zeteo.

stories.title: Talks continue on Trump-brokered prisoner exchange with Russia after Putin claimed that Kyiv was not ready for swap
stories.summary: Negotiations continue on a Trump-brokered prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine after Vladimir Putin claimed Kyiv was not ready. Russia announced a ceasefire for May 8–9 coinciding with its Victory Day, but Ukraine proposed starting on May 6, and Russia violated the ceasefire.

stories.title: Netanyahu hints at US troop deployment against Iran in CBS interview
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu suggested in a CBS "60 Minutes" interview that US troops could be deployed against Iran, hinting that President Trump shares his view on the need for a ground operation. He stated the conflict is "not over."

stories.title: EU Ministers to Discuss Possibility of Direct Talks With Russia
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers are set to discuss the possibility of direct talks with Russia. President Vladimir Putin has proposed former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder as a potential negotiator in discussions with the European Union.

stories.title: Ukraine could receive first funds from €90 billion EU loan next week – Commissioner Kos
stories.summary: EU Commissioner Kos indicated that Ukraine may receive the first disbursement from the EU's €90 billion loan as early as next week.

stories.title: How smokers in Gaza are using molokhia instead of tobacco
stories.summary: Amid severe restrictions on imports including cigarettes, smokers in Gaza have turned to molokhia and other plant-based substitutes as affordable tobacco has become unavailable.

stories.title: Taking advantage of Ukraine ceasefire, Jewish couples wed in joint ceremony in Kyiv
stories.summary: During a temporary Ukraine ceasefire observed from May 9 to 11 in honour of Victory Day, multiple Jewish couples held a joint wedding ceremony in Kyiv, including a 92-year-old couple.

stories.title: Cross-strait ties are ‘not state-to-state’, KMT vice-chair tells senior Beijing official
stories.summary: The relationship between mainland China and Taiwan is not one of state-to-state relations, Chang Rong-kung, vice-chairman of the Kuomintang (KMT), the island’s main opposition party, told Beijing’s to

stories.title: Russia’s Project 21980 “Grachonok”, equipped with Igla missiles and grenade launchers, just got new defense
stories.summary: Russia is adding protective netting to its Project 21980 "Grachonok" anti-sabotage boats, which are equipped with Igla missiles and grenade launchers. The additional defenses aim to address the vessels' vulnerability to attack.

stories.title: NGO Gav Lalochem seeks US Diaspora support to aid reintegration of IDF combat veterans
stories.summary: Israeli NGO Gav Lalochem is touring the United States to seek support from the American Jewish Diaspora for programs helping IDF combat veterans reintegrate into civilian life.

stories.title: South Africa: Several Weather Warnings Issued for Northern, Western, Eastern Cape
stories.summary: The South African Weather Service issued warnings for very cold, wet, and windy conditions across parts of the Northern Cape, Western Cape, and Eastern Cape provinces, expected to persist until Tuesday.

stories.title: Daily Briefing May 11 – Will ‘unacceptable’ Iran proposal push Trump to war?
stories.summary: Diplomatic discussions are underway regarding upcoming Lebanon-Israel talks, Prime Minister Netanyahu's recent 60 Minutes interview, and a proposal to reboot US-Israel cooperation, all set against the backdrop of the rejected Iranian negotiation proposal.

stories.title: Ukraine firmly rejects Schröder as EU negotiator – FM Sybiha
stories.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha stated that Kyiv firmly rejects former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder as a potential EU negotiator, a candidacy reportedly proposed by Russia.

stories.title: Israeli forces send reinforcements Qalandiya refugee camp as raid continues
stories.summary: The Israeli military deployed additional troops to Qalandiya refugee camp in the occupied West Bank after a Palestinian man opened fire on Israeli border police. The gunman was reportedly shot; a young man was also seriously wounded by Israeli fire, according to Wafa news agency.

stories.title: Trump’s State Department refused to recognize Lukashenka in 2020. Today he’s a “friend.”
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump called Belarusian leader Alexander Lukashenka a "friend" following a prisoner exchange deal, despite the State Department refusing to recognize Lukashenka in 2020. A Belarusian bank linked to financing Russian munitions has reportedly regained access to the dollar system.

stories.title: Russian Instagram users voice anger over rising prices, utility bills, and internet restrictions
stories.summary: Russian users continue to access Instagram despite its 2022 ban following the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Posts critical of authorities have increased, with users expressing frustration over internet outages, rising food prices, and utility costs through jokes, memes, and direct commentary.

stories.title: ISW: Russia’s “Victory Day ceasefire” reduced combat but didn’t stop it
stories.summary: The Institute for the Study of War reported that Russia's self-declared Victory Day ceasefire on May 8–9 reduced but did not halt combat. Russian forces attacked Ukrainian positions across six oblasts on the second day, killing at least two civilians in Kherson.

stories.title: Exclusive: Iran agrees to hold nuclear talks within 30 days
stories.summary: Iran agreed to hold discussions on its nuclear program within 30 days as part of a 14-point response to a US proposal aimed at ending the ongoing war between the two countries.

stories.title: Who is Gerhard Schroeder, Putin’s pick for Ukraine peace talks mediation?
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed former German Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder as a mediator for Ukraine peace talks, raising questions about his acceptability to Kyiv and Western governments.

stories.title: Israel’s Noam Bettan keeps singing through Eurovision boycott storm
stories.summary: Israeli Eurovision contestant Noam Bettan discussed the challenges he faced amid boycott calls as he prepared to represent Israel at the competition.

stories.title: ‘Truly terrifying’: Alberta voter data breach raises fears for Canada’s electoral integrity
stories.summary: Debates over secession overshadowed by revelations separatist-linked group gained access to list of electorsThe illegal use of voter information by rightwing separatists in the province of Alberta has

stories.title: PMD issues Glof alert for KP, Gilgit-Baltistan as rainfall predicted in upper Pakistan
stories.summary: Pakistan's Meteorological Department issued a glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) alert for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Gilgit-Baltistan as a moderate westerly weather system was expected to bring heavy rainfall to upper mountain regions.

stories.title: West has power to end Russia’s war against Ukraine — it’s choosing not to: Human rights lawyer tells us why
stories.summary: Human rights lawyer Simon Papuashvili argued that Western governments possess sufficient leverage to end Russia's war against Ukraine but are choosing not to exercise it. He discussed what measures would be required to stop Russia.

stories.title: Iran war ‘not over,’ uranium must be removed: Netanyahu
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that the war with Iran is 'not over' and demanded the removal of Iran's uranium. President Trump separately said Iran was 'militarily defeated' and claimed the uranium could be removed 'whenever we want.'

stories.title: EU could open all Ukraine negotiation clusters in July – Commissioner Kos
stories.summary: EU Commissioner Kos said all clusters in Ukraine's EU accession negotiations could be opened as early as July, with the first cluster potentially launched by the end of June.

stories.title: In India, heat-triggered insurance offers 'some relief'
stories.summary: A parametric insurance scheme in India automatically pays out to informal workers like street sellers when temperatures exceed specific thresholds for consecutive days, helping them forgo work during dangerous heat without losing all income.

stories.title: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer 'not walking away' after local election mauling
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer acknowledged responsibility for Labour's poor local election results but vowed to remain in office and address the party's shortcomings.

stories.title: Trump rejects Iran's response to US peace proposal as 'unacceptable'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump on Sunday branded Iran's terms for ending the Middle East war "totally unacceptable," raising the likelihood of renewed conflict after weeks of negotiations. Iran had respond

stories.title: Russian maternity hospitals mark Victory Day by dressing newborns in military caps with St. George’s ribbons
stories.summary: Maternity Hospital No. 2 in Vladikavkaz, Russia, dressed newborns in military caps and pinned St. George's ribbons to them to mark Victory Day on May 9.

stories.title: PM Starmer clings on to power as Labour rivals make moves
stories.summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces mounting pressure following Labour's disastrous local election results. Meanwhile, Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi's prison diaries were featured in the Guardian, and Spanish sports papers celebrated Barcelona's La Liga championship.

stories.title: Hantavirus outbreak: US, French nationals test positive after evacuating ship
stories.summary: An American citizen and a French woman evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship tested positive for hantavirus, officials confirmed Monday. Spain defended its sanitary protocols during the complex evacuation of 94 passengers of 19 nationalities from the vessel moored in the Canary Islands.

stories.title: Iran Nobel winner Narges Mohammadi released on bail for medical treatment
stories.summary: Iranian authorities released Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi on bail on Sunday following concerns about her deteriorating health. Supporters had warned she was at risk of dying in Zanjan prison after suffering two suspected heart attacks, and she has been transferred to Tehran for medical treatment.

stories.title: Russia, China and Iran: What do Beijing and Moscow want to gain from conflict?
stories.summary: Iran and the United States reached an impasse over ending their conflict as a ceasefire grew increasingly fragile. Western observers say Russia and China are providing crucial support to Tehran, while both Moscow and Beijing publicly advocate for de-escalation.

stories.title: Body found of one of two missing US soldiers in Morocco: Moroccan army
stories.summary: The Moroccan army announced it recovered the body of a US soldier who went missing during an international military training exercise in southern Morocco. A second US soldier also went missing during the exercise.

stories.title: Kenya: French President Macron Goes On Morning Run With Marathon GOAT Kipchoge
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron went on a morning run in Nairobi with Kenyan marathon legend and two-time world record holder Eliud Kipchoge ahead of the opening day of the Africa Forward Summit.

stories.title: Under-threat UK PM Starmer vows to prove ‘doubters’ wrong
stories.summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer delivered a speech vowing to prove his "doubters" wrong after Labour suffered disastrous results in local and regional elections. Starmer pledged his party would do "better" as he sought to quell a growing threat to his leadership from restless lawmakers.

stories.title: Middle East crisis live: Trump rejects Iran response to US peace proposal as Tehran warns of new attacks
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's response to a peace proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable," while Tehran warned of retaliation against any new U.S. strikes or foreign warships in the Strait of Hormuz. Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan planned to visit Qatar for talks on the conflict and regional navigational safety.

stories.title: Report: Russia’s FSO bans officials from wearing watches at meetings with Putin
stories.summary: Russia's Federal Protective Service reportedly banned officials from wearing wristwatches during meetings with President Vladimir Putin, according to the Telegram channel Mozhem Obyasnit.

stories.title: Gaza death toll rises
stories.summary: The cumulative Palestinian death toll in Gaza since October 2023 has reached 72,740, with 172,192 wounded, according to Wafa news agency citing medical sources. Since a ceasefire was imposed in October 2025, Israel has killed approximately 854 more people in the territory.

stories.title: Russian forces launch 250 attacks on Ukrainian border units in one day, most using drones
stories.summary: Russian forces carried out 250 attacks on Ukrainian border guard units in a single day, with 150 of those attacks conducted using drones.

stories.title: Israel's war on Gaza fuels surge in babies born with deformities
stories.summary: Doctors in Gaza report a significant increase in babies born with deformities, which they attribute to Israeli bombardment, toxic fumes, hunger, and the collapse of prenatal healthcare services.

stories.title: Former Qatar PM: Netanyahu using Iran war to reshape Middle East
stories.summary: Former Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim warned that Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is using the war on Iran to reshape the Middle East, calling the Strait of Hormuz crisis the conflict's most dangerous consequence and advocating for a Gulf NATO-style alliance.

stories.title: Taiwan civilians sharpen self-defence skills ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.summary: Taiwanese civilians are enrolling in self-defence courses in growing numbers amid concerns that China could use force against the island, with interest rising ahead of a planned Trump-Xi summit.

stories.title: EU’s Kallas criticises Putin’s ‘very cynical’ Ukraine ceasefire calls and rejects suggestion of Schröder as mediator – Europe live
stories.summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas criticized Russian President Vladimir Putin's ceasefire proposals for Ukraine as "very cynical" and rejected the suggestion of former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder as a mediator. Separately, Poland's former justice minister Zbigniew Ziobro, facing over 20 criminal charges, left Hungary for the United States.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone strike on empty Baltic fuel depot prompts top-level resignation – in Latvia
stories.summary: A Ukrainian drone intended for a target in Russia struck an empty fuel depot in Latvia after what a Ukrainian official described as Russian GPS spoofing that diverted the aircraft. The incident, which hit a Baltic nation instead of its intended Russian target, prompted high-level political consequences in Latvia.

stories.title: Kenya: Meet the Kenyans On a Roll Manufacturing Electric Vehicles of the Future
stories.summary: Kenyan entrepreneurs are manufacturing electric vehicles in Nairobi, with electric mobility emerging as a key topic at the Africa Forward Summit co-organized by France and Kenya.

stories.title: France's Macron defends Europe role in Africa as he seeks reset in Nairobi
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron used a two-day economic summit in Nairobi to defend European engagement in Africa, contrasting it with China's approach and urging African leaders to address governance challenges.

stories.title: EU’s top diplomat ‘hopeful’ bloc will vote to sanction violent West Bank settlers
stories.summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas expressed optimism that the bloc would vote to sanction seven violent West Bank settlers or settler organizations during Monday's meeting, citing a shift in political consensus following a change in Hungary's government.

stories.title: Trump rejects ‘unacceptable’ Iranian terms for ending war
stories.summary: President Trump rejected Iran's formal response to the latest US peace proposal, conveyed through Pakistani mediators, aimed at ending the ongoing Gulf conflict. Iranian President Pezeshkian stated that dialogue 'does not mean surrender or retreat.'

stories.title: Australia include uncapped trio on white-ball tours of Pakistan, Bangladesh
stories.summary: Australia named squads for upcoming white-ball tours of Pakistan and Bangladesh featuring three uncapped players: all-rounder Liam Scott, batter Ollie Peake, and T20 specialist Joel Davies. Mitchell Marsh will captain all squads.

stories.title: Pistorius arrives in Kyiv to co-build the deep-strike weapons Europe lacks
stories.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius traveled by train to Kyiv to discuss co-developing deep-strike weapons that Europe currently lacks, as Berlin works to strengthen deterrence against Russia.

stories.title: Sudan: Türk Issues High Alert On Widening Sudan Conflict Amid Increased Use of Drones
stories.summary: UN Human Rights Chief Volker Türk condemned the rising use of armed drones in Sudan's conflict and their deadly impact on civilians. He warned of intensified and widening violence in coming weeks that could increase displacement and disrupt critical aid flows.

stories.title: Somalia: Democratic Elections Held Peacefully in Somalia's South West State
stories.summary: Local council elections were held peacefully in the Waajid district of Somalia's South West State, with polling stations closing and vote counting beginning, according to election officials in Baidoa.

stories.title: Govt reduces tariffs at Gwadar Port in bid to boost global traffic
stories.summary: Pakistan's Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Junaid Anwar Chaudhry announced major tariff reductions at Gwadar Port, including a 25 percent cut in berthing fees for container ships and a 40 percent reduction in transshipment charges, to attract global transit traffic.

stories.title: Iran says US making ‘unreasonable’ demands in negotiations to end war
stories.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei called Tehran's proposal to end the US-Iran conflict and unblock the Strait of Hormuz "generous," while characterizing US demands as unreasonable.

stories.title: Five people injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv region over past day
stories.summary: Russian attacks struck the city of Kharkiv and seven other settlements in the Kharkiv region on May 10, injuring five people.

stories.title: Britain’s Starmer vows to prove ‘doubters’ wrong as he fights ouster calls
stories.summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer delivered a major speech vowing to prove his "doubters" wrong after Labour suffered its worst governing-party local election results in over three decades. He pledged to put "Britain at the heart of Europe" in a bid to restore public confidence and quell a mounting party rebellion.

stories.title: Macron defends Europe’s role in Africa as he seeks reset in Nairobi
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron used a two-day economic summit in Nairobi to defend Europe's engagement in Africa, contrasting it with China's approach and urging African leaders to address governance challenges.

stories.title: REPLAY: Under-pressure UK PM addresses nation after election losses
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer addressed the nation on Monday, pledging to stay in office and deliver results after Labour suffered its worst local election performance for a governing party in over three decades. A growing internal rebellion has emerged, with a former junior minister threatening to trigger a leadership contest unless Starmer pursues radical policy changes.

stories.title: Iran Nobel winner released on bail for medical treatment: supporters
stories.summary: Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi was released on bail for medical treatment after being hospitalized for 10 days. Activists had raised serious concerns about her declining health while in custody.

stories.title: Eurovision fever hits host city Vienna
stories.summary: The Eurovision Song Contest opened festivities in Vienna on Sunday, drawing thousands of fans to the Austrian capital ahead of the grand final on May 16. The 70th edition of the contest has been accompanied by renewed calls for a boycott over Israel's participation, while organizers have scheduled numerous side events throughout the week.

stories.title: Thinktank calls for ‘double lock’ England private rent cap to ease living costs
stories.summary: The UK's Institute for Public Policy Research proposed a "double lock" rent cap for England, linking private rent increases to the lower of consumer price inflation or wage growth. The proposal comes as the chancellor weighs options to ease surging living costs exacerbated by the Iran war's energy impact.

stories.title: Democrats are playing with fire in trying to reclaim tax cuts from Republicans
stories.summary: Some Democratic lawmakers, including Senator Chris Van Hollen, are embracing tax-cut strategies in response to the party's 2024 election loss to Donald Trump. Critics argue this approach risks undermining the party's broader fiscal agenda and barely benefits the middle class.

stories.title: Portrait looted by Nazis found in home of Dutch SS leader's descendants
stories.summary: A portrait believed to have been looted by Nazi leader Hermann Goering during World War Two was discovered in the home of descendants of a Dutch SS leader in the Netherlands.

stories.title: US-Israel war on Iran: Hormuz island tourism takes a hit
stories.summary: More than two months into the US-Israel military campaign against Iran, continued disruption of the Strait of Hormuz is deepening global economic strain. FRANCE 24 reporters visited Iran's Hormuz Island, where the conflict has severely impacted tourism and local residents face growing uncertainty about their livelihoods.

stories.title: Chinese aviation expert lays out plan to sanction-proof domestic passenger planes
stories.summary: Chinese aviation academician Zhang Yanzhong, known as the "father of China's large aircraft," published a blueprint for building a fully self-sufficient supply chain for large passenger jets. The plan, developed through the Chinese Academy of Engineering, addresses the risk of being cut off from Western-made components due to sanctions.

stories.title: EU to impose new sanctions over Russia’s abduction of Ukrainian children
stories.summary: The European Union announced it will impose new sanctions on May 11 related to Russia's abduction of Ukrainian children from occupied territories. The measures target individuals and entities involved in the forced transfer of minors.

stories.title: Hong Kong urged to expand role in national medical research, breakthroughs
stories.summary: A National Health Commission official urged Hong Kong to expand its role in major national clinical research projects and scientific breakthroughs. The remarks were made at the Hospital Authority Convention, where the authority's chief also pledged to introduce smarter hospital initiatives and more efficient service pathways.

stories.title: Crude oil prices rise as Trump calls Iran's offer 'totally unacceptable'
stories.summary: Benchmark crude oil prices rose on Monday after US President Donald Trump rejected Iran's latest counterproposal to end the Middle East conflict, calling it 'totally unacceptable.' The ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz is affecting global economies, with Indian PM Narendra Modi urging reduced fuel use and Chinese inflation rising above expectations. Separately, French President Macron announced over €1 billion in investment in Kenya.

stories.title: FRANCE 24 report: Over 17,000 US and allied troops take part in Balikatan drills
stories.summary: Over 17,000 US and allied troops are participating in Balikatan, the largest-ever joint military exercises between the United States and the Philippines. The drills, conducted across the Philippines, aim to bolster regional security amid growing Chinese assertiveness. French troops are participating for the first time following Paris's Visiting Forces Agreement with Manila.

stories.title: Disappearances in Mexico involving state at ‘alarming’ rate, says report
stories.summary: A report from the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights found that state actors are involved in disappearances in Mexico at an "alarming" rate. More than 130,000 people have gone missing in Mexico, mostly in the last 20 years since the government declared its war on drug cartels.

stories.title: Keir Starmer vows to prove doubters wrong in make-or-break leadership speech
stories.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer vowed to fight any leadership challenge and prove his doubters wrong in a major speech following Labour's worst local election results for a governing party in over three decades. He pledged to nationalize British Steel and seek a new deal with the EU.

stories.title: Can FPV drone threat encourage Israel-Ukraine cooperation? - analysis
stories.summary: An analysis examines whether Hezbollah's use of fibre-optic-tethered FPV drones in Lebanon could drive greater military cooperation between Israel and Ukraine. Hezbollah has shifted to small quadcopter-type drones as Israel maintains a buffer zone inside Lebanese territory.

stories.title: Iran describes its proposal to end war with US as 'legitimate' and 'generous'
stories.summary: Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei described Tehran's proposal to end the war with the US and reopen the Strait of Hormuz as "legitimate" and "generous." Iran's demands include ending the blockade, unfreezing Iranian assets, and ensuring safe passage through Hormuz.

stories.title: Russia has no right to appoint EU negotiator – Kallas
stories.summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas stated that Russia has no right to designate the European Union's negotiator. Her remarks came in response to reports that Moscow favored former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder, a known lobbyist for Russian companies, for such a role.

stories.title: Kenya: Gachagua Links Mandera Killings to Alleged Jubaland Incursion Into Kenya
stories.summary: Former Kenyan Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua alleged that the killing of six civilians in Mandera was linked to an incursion by Jubaland forces operating inside Kenyan territory.

stories.title: South Korea condemns attack on cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz, vows response
stories.summary: South Korea condemned an attack on a cargo ship operated by a South Korean shipper in the Strait of Hormuz, which experts said resulted in a fire. Seoul vowed to respond to the incident.

stories.title: Iran executes man who worked in ‘satellite field’ for allegedly spying for Mossad, CIA
stories.summary: Iran executed 29-year-old aerospace engineering graduate Erfan Shakourzadeh for allegedly spying for Israel's Mossad and the CIA. A rights group said he was forced to confess. Tehran has faced accusations of using its satellite program to advance ballistic missile capabilities.

stories.title: Philippines presidential hopeful Sara Duterte impeached, awaits Senate trial
stories.summary: The Philippine House of Representatives voted 255 out of 318 to impeach Vice President Sara Duterte-Carpio, surpassing the one-third threshold required. She faces a Senate trial on accusations of misusing public funds and accumulating unexplained wealth, which could end her 2028 presidential aspirations.

stories.title: Remains of U.S. soldier who went missing during military exercises in Morocco recovered
stories.summary: The remains of a US soldier who went missing on May 2 during African Lion, an annual multinational military exercise in Morocco, have been recovered. A second soldier also went missing during the exercise.

stories.title: Narendra Modi urges Indians to conserve fuel amid war on Iran
stories.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi called on citizens to conserve fuel as the ongoing US-Iran war disrupts global energy supplies.

stories.title: Oil rises $4 after Trump rejects Iran's response to US peace proposal
stories.summary: Oil prices surged after President Trump rejected Iran's response to a US peace proposal as 'unacceptable.' Brent crude climbed over 4 percent to $105.45 per barrel amid continued supply fears linked to restricted transit through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Evacuated US and French MV Hondius passengers test positive for hantavirus
stories.summary: A French woman and an American national evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship tested positive for hantavirus. The French passenger was taken to a Paris hospital in serious condition, while the American was flown to Nebraska and reported as asymptomatic. Spain defended its sanitary measures during the evacuation of 94 passengers in Tenerife.

stories.title: Germany’s Defense Minister arrives in Kyiv
stories.summary: German Federal Defense Minister Boris Pistorius made an unannounced visit to Kyiv on Monday, May 11. The trip underscores ongoing German support for Ukraine amid the continuing conflict with Russia.

stories.title: U.S. President Trump to pay state visit to China from May 13 to 15
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump will make a state visit to China from May 13 to 15, amid the ongoing US-Israel-Iran conflict causing a global energy crisis and rising US-China tensions over issues including Taiwan.

stories.title: Somali piracy disrupts global shipping and trade routes
stories.summary: Piracy off the coast of Somalia has resurged as commercial ships reroute around Africa to avoid Middle East conflict zones. The trend is increasing insurance premiums, transit times, and security costs for global supply chains.

stories.title: Somali piracy adds new strain to global shipping and trade routes
stories.summary: Piracy off the coast of Somalia has resurged as commercial vessels reroute around Africa to avoid conflict zones in the Middle East. The increase is driving up insurance premiums, transit times, and security costs, straining global supply chains.

stories.title: Iran war 'not over,' uranium must be removed: Netanyahu
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated in an interview that the war with Iran is far from over and called for Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium to be "taken out."

stories.title: South Africa: Somebody Call Hasina
stories.summary: South African health official Hasina Subedar, who began her career as a nurse in Pietermaritzburg 30 years ago, is now leading the rollout of a game-changing HIV prevention medication across 360 clinics in the country.

stories.title: Latvian Defense Minister resigns, following lagging response to drone incursions
stories.summary: Latvia's Defense Minister resigned after the country's military drone detection systems failed to identify an incoming aircraft that crashed on Latvian territory. Mobile warnings were not sent to residents' phones until approximately one hour after the drone had already struck, drawing criticism over the lagging emergency response.

stories.title: Iconic snow leopard makes a comeback in rugged terrain of Chitral
stories.summary: The snow leopard is making a comeback in Chitral, in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, after a 13-year absence. Multiple sightings across various valleys have been confirmed, marking a significant wildlife conservation milestone for the region.

stories.title: Exclusive: Iraqi officials say US shielded secret Israeli base
stories.summary: Iraqi officials told The New Arab that the United States helped conceal a secret Israeli military base in Najaf, Iraq. The base's existence came to light after Iraqi troops were reportedly attacked near the site in March.

stories.title: Eight-year-old boy finds 1,700-year-old statuette fragment while hiking in Negev
stories.summary: An eight-year-old boy discovered a 1,700-year-old statuette fragment while hiking in Israel's Negev desert. An Israel Antiquities Authority archaeologist said the artifact may depict the Roman god Jupiter.

stories.title: China readies for Trump visit amid rebound in trade growth
stories.summary: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent are scheduled to meet for trade talks in Seoul on Wednesday ahead of President Trump's state visit to Beijing. Trump's visit, running Wednesday to Friday, would be the first by a U.S. president to China in almost nine years.

stories.title: Kenya: France to Host African Summit in Kenya, in Bid to 'Diversify Alliances'
stories.summary: France hosted the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi, Kenya, marking the first time it staged such an event in an English-speaking country as it seeks to diversify its alliances on the continent.

stories.title: Canada labels Sikh extremism a threat while accusing India of meddling
stories.summary: Canada's spy agency released a report identifying Khalistani extremism as a national security threat, which analysts say may accelerate a diplomatic reset with India. However, allegations of interference by New Delhi on Canadian soil continue to complicate the bilateral relationship.

stories.title: Russians shell 13 settlements in Kherson region over past day, leaving two killed, others injured
stories.summary: Russian forces shelled 13 settlements in Ukraine's Kherson region over the past 24 hours, killing two people and injuring two others. The attacks targeted civilian areas across the region.

stories.title: Passengers evacuated from hantavirus-affected cruise ship
stories.summary: Passengers evacuated from the hantavirus-affected cruise ship MV Hondius, anchored in Tenerife, began flying home on military and government aircraft. One American tested positive and a French traveler developed symptoms during repatriation flights on Sunday.

stories.title: ‘A modern Eichmann trial’: Lawmakers tout imminent passage of bill to try Oct. 7 perpetrators
stories.summary: Israeli lawmakers are advancing legislation to try approximately 300 captured participants in the October 7 attack. Justice Minister Yariv Levin said the bill would serve justice and preserve the historical record of the massacre.

stories.title: More passengers from hantavirus-hit cruise ship test positive
stories.summary: A French woman and an American national evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship have tested positive for hantavirus, officials confirmed Monday. The French passenger was hospitalized in Paris after falling ill, while the complex operation to repatriate passengers of 19 nationalities continued.

stories.title: New regional order
stories.summary: An opinion piece examines how the US-Israel war on Iran has reshaped the regional geopolitical order, noting that despite immense damage and loss of leadership, Iran's government has not fallen, unlike previous US regime-change targets such as Afghanistan and Iraq.

stories.title: Body believed to be alleged triple murderer Julian Ingram found near abandoned ute in ‘decomposed state’
stories.summary: A decomposed body found near an abandoned vehicle roughly 50 km from Lake Cargelligo in New South Wales is believed to be Julian Ingram, 37. He was the subject of a large-scale manhunt since January after allegedly shooting and killing his pregnant former partner Sophie Quinn, her boyfriend, and her aunt.

stories.title: The Global Sumud Flotilla is sailing on, here is why
stories.summary: The Global Sumud Flotilla announced it would continue its maritime mission after part of the flotilla was attacked by Israeli forces. Organizers said the incident reinforced their determination to proceed.

stories.title: PM Starmer’s dreadful Monday: will a speech overcome the greatest challenge to his political future
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer faced the greatest threat to his premiership on Monday, delivering a speech promising bolder action on major challenges. He sought to persuade Labour MPs not to replace him as party leader following poor election results.

stories.title: War update: 180 combat engagements over past day
stories.summary: Ukraine's military recorded 180 combat engagements with Russian forces along the frontline on May 10. The clashes occurred across multiple sectors as fighting continues throughout eastern and southern Ukraine.

stories.title: Malaysia’s fuel subsidy headache leaves Anwar ‘scrambling for solution’
stories.summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim faces a politically difficult decision on how to reform fuel subsidies by defining income thresholds for eligibility. The Middle East energy shock has strained government finances, forcing authorities to balance fiscal discipline against the risk of angering middle-class voters.

stories.title: Trump says Iran truce on 'life support', rejects peace proposal
stories.summary: President Donald Trump called Tehran's peace proposal 'totally unacceptable' while Israel intensified its bombing campaign in Lebanon despite a ceasefire. Trump characterized the truce between the U.S. and Iran as being on 'life support.'

stories.title: US-Iran talks stall after Trump, Tehran trade rejections
stories.summary: US-Iran peace negotiations stalled after President Trump rejected Tehran's proposal as "totally unacceptable." Meanwhile, Israel intensified its bombing campaign in Lebanon despite an existing truce.

stories.title: Returns on multipolarity
stories.summary: An analysis argues that global politics is shifting toward multipolarity, with the US experiencing declining ability and willingness to project power, as evidenced by challenges in Eastern Europe and the Persian Gulf, driven by internal structural pressures.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s property recovery could be more robust than many think
stories.summary: S&P Global Ratings reported that Hong Kong's property market may experience a stronger-than-expected recovery, citing competitive bids at recent residential land auctions. S&P noted Hong Kong has become the first major city in China whose property market has bottomed, potentially attracting mainland developers.

stories.title: Is the UN irrelevant?
stories.summary: An opinion piece argues the UN is both relevant and irrelevant: it has failed to address the Middle East crisis triggered by the US-Israeli attack on Iran, yet continues to play vital roles in humanitarian assistance, including aid to Palestinians in Gaza.

stories.title: Israel faces Hezbollah’s attrition trap on the Lebanese border - opinion
stories.summary: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem stated that the organization is returning to guerrilla warfare tactics against the Israeli Defense Forces along the Lebanese border. An opinion piece argues that Israel faces an attrition trap set by Hezbollah in the area.

stories.title: In Malaysia, ex-Proton CEO’s self-reliance sermon spurs backlash: ‘spare us’
stories.summary: Former Proton CEO Syed Zainal Abidin Syed Tahir faced online backlash after calling on Malays to abandon a "mentality of waiting for aid" at a dialogue founded by Malaysian Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi. Social media users pointed to Proton's own long history of government support.

stories.title: Britain, France to host multinational meeting on mission to escort ships through Hormuz
stories.summary: Britain and France will host a multinational meeting to discuss a naval escort mission for commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Organizers indicated the mission would only commence once a sustained ceasefire or peace deal in the region is reached.

stories.title: Uganda: Uganda Faces Critical Shortage of Specialist Doctors - Aceng
stories.summary: Ugandan Health Minister Jane Ruth Aceng warned of a critical shortage of specialist doctors in the country, saying the gap is straining Uganda's capacity to deliver advanced and specialized healthcare services.

stories.title: Art looted from Jewish collector hanging in home of Dutch SS leader’s family, sleuth says
stories.summary: A researcher discovered that a painting looted from a Jewish collector during World War II, "Portrait of a Young Girl" by Toon Kelder, has been displayed in the home of a Dutch SS leader's descendants. The theft has passed the statute of limitations.

stories.title: One dead, three injured in Ramle shooting, police rule incident as criminal
stories.summary: One person was killed and three others were injured in a shooting incident in Ramle, Israel. Israeli police classified the incident as criminal in nature, reporting that the shooter opened fire near a local market after the victim attempted to flee from the shooter's home.

stories.title: Russia loses 920 troops, 76 artillery systems in war against Ukraine over past day
stories.summary: Ukraine's military estimated that Russia lost 920 troops and 76 artillery systems in the past 24 hours. Total estimated Russian combat losses since the February 2022 full-scale invasion have reached approximately 1,342,030 personnel as of May 11, 2026.

stories.title: Weather tracker: US and Mexico brace for heatwave as deadly floods hit South Africa
stories.summary: A severe heatwave is expected across western parts of the United States and Mexico, with temperatures forecast 10–15°C above average in some areas. The U.S. National Weather Service issued heat advisories for California and Arizona, while deadly floods struck South Africa's Western and Northern Cape.

stories.title: Iran war day 73: Trump and Tehran clash over latest peace proposals
stories.summary: On day 73 of the US-Iran war, negotiations remained deadlocked as President Trump rejected Tehran's latest peace proposal as "totally unacceptable." Brent crude prices rose amid the continuing impasse.

stories.title: Situationer: Punjab set to launch land-lease scheme amid concerns
stories.summary: Punjab's Board of Revenue is preparing to launch the Apna Khet, Apna Rozgar (AKAR) land-leasing scheme, initially covering 124,363 acres of state land. The initiative uses GIS-based mapping to allocate unused land to landless farmers for cultivation.

stories.title: Trump rejects Iran peace offer, raising fears of escalation
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's latest peace proposal, delivered via Pakistani mediators, calling it "totally unacceptable" in a social media post. The rejection raised fears of further escalation in the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Six people found dead in boxcar in Laredo, Texas, police say
stories.summary: Police in Laredo, Texas, reported that six bodies were discovered inside a train boxcar on Sunday, May 10. Authorities are investigating the circumstances of the deaths.

stories.title: Ex-Israeli PM: Hezbollah is the enemy of Lebanon and must be disarmed
stories.summary: Former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert called for the disarmament of Hezbollah, describing the group as an enemy of Lebanon. He spoke about the 2006 war, Lebanon's situation, and the ongoing US-Israeli military campaign against Iran.

stories.title: Spain’s Nico Williams sustains hamstring injury before World Cup
stories.summary: Spain's Nico Williams suffered a hamstring injury during Athletic Bilbao's 1-0 loss to Valencia, leaving the pitch before half-time. The injury raises concerns about his availability for the upcoming World Cup.

stories.title: Imran says ‘army is mine, country is mine’: PTI
stories.summary: Pakistan's PTI party marked the first anniversary of what it calls the 'Marka-i-Haq' military response to Indian aggression, claiming that jailed founder Imran Khan sent a message from Adiala jail stating 'the army is mine, and the country is mine.'

stories.title: Tankers reportedly disable trackers to avoid attacks in Hormuz
stories.summary: Three oil tankers carrying crude passed through the Strait of Hormuz with tracking systems disabled to avoid potential Iranian attacks, according to Reuters citing Kpler and LSEG shipping data. Two very large crude carriers, the Agios Fanourios I and Kiara M, each carried about 2 million barrels of Iraqi crude.

stories.title: Netanyahu wants to wean Israel off US military support, he tells CBS news network
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told CBS News that he wants to reduce Israel's dependence on US military support. Israel currently receives approximately S$4.8 billion in US military aid annually.

stories.title: Ukrainian officer: Russian frontline assaults now rare as 60-70% of infiltrators die before reaching Ukrainian lines
stories.summary: A Ukrainian senior lieutenant reported on Telegram that Russian frontline assault operations have become rare, with 60–70% of infiltrators dying before reaching Ukrainian positions. Small-group infiltration has become Russia's main remaining tactic.

stories.title: US Senate expected to confirm Kevin Warsh as next Federal Reserve chair
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate is expected to confirm Kevin Warsh as the next chair of the Federal Reserve, succeeding Jerome Powell. The confirmation comes as President Donald Trump continues efforts to influence the central bank during a turbulent economic period.

stories.title: Why China’s new duty-free access is a lifeline for South African exporters
stories.summary: China began granting zero-tariff access to South African exports from May 1, removing the 10% tariff on apples. The first shipments cleared included 24 tonnes of apples through Shenzhen Bay port and 6,000 bottles of wine processed in Hunan province, providing a lifeline for South African exporters seeking market diversification.

stories.title: Plan to make 5G handsets ‘affordable’ hits roadblock
stories.summary: A Pakistani government proposal to make 5G-enabled smartphones available on instalment plans has stalled, with authorities still awaiting responses from industry stakeholders following the country's 5G spectrum auction held in March.

stories.title: Russians strike Zaporizhzhia region 785 times in one day, leaving one killed, two injured
stories.summary: Russian forces carried out 785 strikes on 36 settlements in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region over one day. One person was killed and two others were injured in attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.

stories.title: No butts: case dismissed after Woolworths worker claims hurt feelings over plumber’s crack
stories.summary: Australia's Fair Work Commission dismissed a former Woolworths employee's unfair dismissal claim filed after he was told to cover up exposed clothing. Deputy President Alan Colman rejected the case, warning there is no disincentive for speculative claims.

stories.title: Foreign economic assistance inflows rise nearly 20pc
stories.summary: Foreign economic assistance inflows to Pakistan rose nearly 20 percent to $6.594 billion during July-March of the current fiscal year, driven largely by IMF programme support, compared to $5.507 billion in the same period last year.

stories.title: Africa Forward Summit: France seeks fresh start with Africa
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron began a visit to Kenya ahead of the Africa Forward Summit, an event designed to reframe France's relationship with Africa as a partnership of equals rather than one shaped by its colonial past.

stories.title: Morning update
stories.summary: Diplomatic prospects between Washington and Tehran have dimmed after President Trump called Iran's latest response to the US peace proposal "totally unacceptable." Meanwhile, Israeli strikes in Lebanon are intensifying, oil prices are rising, and concerns grow over shipping security in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: US widens drive to revoke citizenship of foreign-born Americans
stories.summary: The Trump administration's Justice Department has expanded denaturalisation proceedings against roughly a dozen naturalised US citizens, including an Indian businessman, over allegations of fraud, terrorism links, and financial crimes. Civil liberties groups have raised concerns.

stories.title: Gaza filmmakers slam BBC after shelved documentary wins Bafta
stories.summary: A documentary about Gaza filmmakers, previously shelved by the BBC, won a BAFTA award. Journalist and presenter Ramita Navai accepted the award and condemned censorship and silencing of the film's creators.

stories.title: If Starmer is serious about stamping out antisemitism, he must end Britain's blind support for Israel
stories.summary: A commentary argues that UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer should reassess Britain's relationship with Israel, contending that Israeli government actions are contributing to risks for Jewish communities in Britain.

stories.title: Taiwan confident in US ties, hopes Trump-Xi summit brings no ‘surprises’
stories.summary: Taiwan expressed confidence in its relationship with the United States ahead of a planned summit between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Taipei voiced hope that the meeting would not produce any unexpected developments affecting Taiwan's interests.

stories.title: Temperatures up to +22°C, rain expected across Ukraine on Monday
stories.summary: Forecasters predicted cloudy weather with clear spells across Ukraine on Monday, May 11, with temperatures reaching up to 22°C and rain expected in most regions, along with thunderstorms in some areas.

stories.title: Temperatures up to +22°C, rain expected across Ukraine on Monday
stories.summary: Cloudy weather with intermittent rain and temperatures reaching up to 22°C was forecast across Ukraine on Monday, May 11. Thunderstorms were expected in some areas.

stories.title: Malawi: Cost of Living Crisis Deepens As Household Expenses Jump 8 Percent in One Month
stories.summary: Malawian households saw expenses surge by more than 8 percent in April alone, driven by rising fuel prices and a weakening economy, deepening the country's cost of living crisis.

stories.title: Far-right provocateurs hurl homophobic abuse at gay secularist activist in Tel Aviv
stories.summary: A far-right group led by government-aligned activist Mordechai David targeted gay secularist activist Naor Narkis and his partner in Tel Aviv with homophobic slurs and abuse.

stories.title: Iran executes man accused of spying for CIA and Mossad
stories.summary: Iran executed Erfan Shakourzadeh, a man accused of spying for the CIA and Israel's Mossad. According to Iranian state-linked media, Shakourzadeh worked at a scientific organization involved in satellite activities and allegedly transferred classified information to foreign intelligence services.

stories.title: Iran-Israel war LIVE: Trump rejects Iran’s peace proposal as 'totally unacceptable'
stories.summary: President Donald Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal as "totally unacceptable" after receiving it on May 10. The proposal had raised hopes for a potential breakthrough to end the ongoing Iran-Israel war.

stories.title: Ankara’s Crossroads: Rearmament, Risk, and the Prospect of War with Israel
stories.summary: Speculation about a potential military clash between Israel and Turkey has intensified over the past year, driven by disputes over Syria, the Palestinian territories, and regional security. In December 2025, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu indirectly accused Ankara of seeking to reestablish Ottoman imperial influence over the Levant. Turkish rearmament efforts have added to tensions.

stories.title: Cotton stocks at ‘lowest ebb’ ahead of ginning season
stories.summary: Pakistan's cotton stocks have reportedly dropped below 10,000 bales ahead of the new ginning season, an unprecedented low attributed partly to the closure of the Pakistan-Afghanistan border blocking approximately 500,000 bales. Some textile mills may face partial shutdowns.

stories.title: Philippine parliament start vote on Sara Duterte’s impeachment bid
stories.summary: Philippine lawmakers began voting on the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte-Carpio, which could create a major obstacle to her 2028 presidential bid. A House justice committee had previously found probable cause based on accusations of misusing public funds and threatening President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his wife.

stories.title: Iran says US has not issued World Cup visas for players
stories.summary: The Iran Football Federation said the United States has not yet issued entry visas to Iran's national football team ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Federation president Mehdi Taj said the process was taking an unusually long time and that he planned to seek resolution during a training camp in Türkiye.

stories.title: Kharkiv region hands over batch of pickup trucks to two combat brigades
